9788076.name: Flamy Fried chicken / 辣子鸡

9788079.name: Flamy fried chicken Wings / 炸雞翅

9788080.name: Xiangla Fried Chicken / 辣子鸡

9788085.name: Xiangla Fried chicken wings / 香辣炸鸡翅

9792842.name: Classic Chicken strips / 鸡柳
9792842.description: Chicken strips are slices of chicken meat, typically from the breast or tenderloin, that are breaded and deep-fried or baked until golden brown. Often served as a popular appetiser or main course with dipping sauces, they are similar to chicken tenders but generally represent wider, hand-cut pieces rather than the specific, smaller pectoral muscle known as the tenderloin.

9792843.name: Flamy Chicken Strips / 辣子鸡
9792843.description: Flamy (or "Flaming Hot") chicken strips are breaded, tender white-meat chicken breast fillets, coated in a spicy, crunchy chilli seasoning, often including paprika and red pepper. They feature a fiery, vibrant red exterior with a crispy texture and a juicy, seasoned interior.

9792863.name: Taifeng Chicken Strips / 炸雞排

9813944.name: Suan Fried Chicken Full Leg / 蒜香炸雞脾

9814010.name: Suan Fried Chicken Wings / 蒜香炸鸡翅

Thai Fried Chicken (Premium)

Our Premium Thai Fried Chicken is crafted with authentic Thai spices and fresh ingredients for an unforgettable taste. 2941124.name: Shrimp Tangsu

2941133.name: Seafood Fried Rice
2941133.description: Seafood fried rice is a delectable dish that features a medley of seafood combined with fried rice. Typically, it includes an assortment of seafood such as shrimp, squid, and sometimes crab or other shellfish. The dish is made by stir-frying cooked rice with the seafood and a mix of vegetables like peas, carrots, and green onions. The flavors are enhanced with soy sauce, garlic, and sometimes ginger.

1669717.name: Mixed Fried Rice

2941132.name: Mushroom Fried Rice
2941132.description: Mushroom fried rice is a savory dish made by stir-frying cooked rice with a variety of mushrooms and other complementary ingredients. Typically, mushrooms like shiitake, button, or oyster mushrooms are used to impart a rich and earthy flavor to the dish.

1669716.name: Chicken Fried Rice
1669716.description: Chicken fried rice is a popular Asian dish made by stir-frying pre-cooked rice with diced chicken, vegetables, and seasonings. The dish typically includes ingredients like soy sauce, garlic, ginger, and sometimes peas, carrots, and onions.

1669715.name: Sticky Rice
1669715.description: Sticky rice, also known as glutinous rice, is a type of rice with a high starch content that gives it a sticky and chewy texture when cooked. It is commonly used in various Asian cuisines.

1669722.name: Salmon Avocado Salad
1669722.description: Salmon avocado salad is a simple yet flavorful dish consisting of fresh salmon cubes, ripe avocados, crisp lettuce, and sesame seeds. 1669721.name: Pepper Tuna Salad
1669721.description: Pepper tuna salad is a vibrant dish featuring seared or grilled tuna coated with cracked black pepper, served on a bed of fresh greens. The tuna is typically seared briefly to maintain a tender, rare center.

4748343.name: Baechu Kimchi
4748343.description: Baechu kimchi is a traditional Korean dish and one of the most well-known types of kimchi. It is made by fermenting Napa cabbage with a mixture of Korean red pepper flakes (gochugaru), garlic, ginger, scallions, and other seasonings.

6234116.name: Chicken Momo with Garlic Sauce
6234116.description: 6 pcs - Chicken momo with garlic sauce, while distinct from curry, shares similarities in terms of being a flavorful and saucy dish. The momos themselves are dumplings, typically steamed or pan-fried, filled with minced chicken and spices. The garlic sauce, akin to a gravy, provides additional flavor and moisture to the dish.

6234114.name: Chicken Momo

1669747.name: Tuna Nigiri
1669747.description: 6 pcs - Tuna nigiri is a type of sushi composed of a small, hand-pressed mound of vinegared rice topped with a slice of fresh, raw tuna. This classic sushi offering highlights the natural flavors of the tuna and the seasoned rice, often served with a dab of wasabi between the rice and fish.

1669745.name: Salmon Nigiri
1669745.description: 6 pcsc - Salmon nigiri is a type of sushi consisting of a small mound of vinegared rice topped with a fresh, raw slice of salmon. This classic sushi delicacy showcases the natural flavors of the salmon and the seasoned rice, providing a simple yet delightful culinary experience.

1669744.name: Mixed Nigiri
1669744.description: 6pcs - Mixed nigiri features hand-pressed rice topped with fresh, raw tuna, shrimp, and salmon, offering a diverse and flavorful selection in Japanese sushi cuisine.

4748429.name: Tuna Kim Bap
4748429.description: 6pcs - Tuna kimbap, also known as tuna gimbap, is a Korean dish that features seasoned rice, vegetables, and tuna rolled in seaweed sheets (gim or nori). The filling often includes ingredients such as pickled radish, carrots, spinach, and strips of tuna.

7966608.name: Beef Maki

2941144.name: Dragon Eye Roll
2941144.description: 6pcs - Dragon Eye Roll: Indulge in the mesmerizing flavors of our Dragon Eye Roll. Inside, you'll find a delightful combination of boiled shrimp, tuna, creamy avocado, succulent salmon, and crab stick, creating a symphony of textures. Topped with a drizzle of spicy mayo sauce, a sprinkle of ebiko (fish roe), and a touch of sesame seeds, this roll is a true feast for the senses.

2941145.name: Maguro Katsu Maki
2941145.description: 6 pcs - Maguro Katsu Maki Deluxe: Indulge in the ultimate tuna experience with our Maguro Katsu Maki Deluxe. Generously filled with tuna katsu, a sumptuous blend of deep-fried and succulent tuna, both inside and on top, this roll promises an abundance of rich and satisfying flavors. Complemented by creamy avocado, crisp cucumber, and perfectly seasoned rice, each bite is a harmonious blend of textures.

2941146.name: Salmon Katsu Maki
2941146.description: 6 pcs - Salmon Katsu Maki Deluxe: Elevate your sushi experience with our Salmon Katsu Maki Deluxe. Featuring lavish amounts of salmon katsu salmon that's expertly breaded and deep-fried both inside and on top, this roll promises an abundance of rich and satisfying flavors. Complemented by creamy avocado, crisp cucumber, and perfectly seasoned rice, each bite is a harmonious blend of textures.

1669754.name: Volcano Roll
1669754.description: 6pcs - Volcano Roll: Indulge in the explosive flavors of our Volcano Roll, featuring succulent fried prawn, creamy avocado, and luscious cheese. Torched to perfection and generously drizzled with spicy mayonnaise sauce, this roll delivers a fiery kick. Topped with a crunchy eruption, our Volcano Roll is a symphony of textures and tastes that will ignite your taste buds.

2941143.name: Dragon of Fire Roll
2941143.description: 6pcs - Dragon of Fire Sushi Roll: Ignite your taste buds with our Dragon of Fire Sushi Roll. Inside, revel in the harmony of creamy avocado, succulent crab stick, and crisp carrot, all enhanced with our signature sauce. Topped with a layer of torched crab stick and cucumber, this roll delivers a fiery sensation that will leave you enchanted.

1669757.name: Tiger Roll
1669757.description: 6pcs - Tiger Roll: Unleash the bold flavors of our Tiger Roll, featuring a delectable combination of creamy cheese, ripe avocado, crispy fried prawn, and refreshing cucumber. Topped with a luscious drizzle of honey mustard sauce and a sprinkle of ebiko (fish roe), this roll embodies the perfect balance of textures and tastes.

2941147.name: Naruto Maki Roll
2941147.description: 6 pcs - Tuna & Avocado Naruto Maki: Immerse yourself in the exquisite flavors of our Tuna & Avocado Naruto Maki. This carb-free delight is a lavish ensemble of abundant tuna and creamy avocado nestled within thinly sliced cucumber, offering a refreshing and light alternative to traditional sushi. Each bite is a harmonious blend of the buttery richness of avocado and the succulent taste of premium tuna, creating a memorable sushi experience.

1669758.name: Rainbow California Roll
1669758.description: 6pcs - Rainbow California Roll: Experience a burst of colors and flavors with our Rainbow California Roll. This classic roll is crafted with a center of crab or imitation crab, cucumber, and avocado, wrapped in seaweed and rice. What sets it apart is the vibrant array of fresh sashimi-style fish, including tuna, salmon,  and avocado, artfully arranged on top.

1669755.name: Summer Roll
1669755.description: 6 pcs - Summer Roll: Dive into the vibrant flavors of our Summer Roll, a delightful combination of fried prawn, creamy cheese, avocado, and refreshing cucumber. Topped with luscious tuna and torched to perfection, it's crowned with a tantalizing spicy mayonnaise sauce. This roll is a harmonious blend of textures and tastes, bringing the essence of summer to your palate.

2941152.name: Spicy Tuna Roll
2941152.description: 6pcs - Spicy Tuna Roll: A sushi classic with a spicy twist. Inside, enjoy a tantalizing blend of fresh tuna mixed with a fiery spicy mayo sauce, delivering a perfect harmony of heat and savory goodness. Encased in seaweed and rice, this roll offers a delightful kick for those who appreciate a bit of spice in their sushi. The Spicy Tuna Roll is a flavorful and popular choice, capturing the essence of bold and satisfying sushi enjoyment.

2941150.name: Spicy Salmon Roll
2941150.description: 6 pcs - Spicy Salmon Roll: A zesty and flavorful sushi roll that packs a punch. Inside, you'll find fresh and succulent salmon mixed with a spicy mayo sauce for a kick of heat. This delectable filling is wrapped in seaweed and rice, creating a perfect balance of spicy and savory flavors. The Spicy Salmon Roll is a popular choice for those who crave a bit of heat along with the richness of high-quality salmon in their sushi experience.

1669753.name: Love Maki Roll
1669753.description: 6pcs - Love Maki Roll: Indulge in the romantic charm of our Love Maki Roll, shaped with affection and crafted with a delightful combination of cheese, sumptuous salmon, and creamy avocado inside. This special creation is not only a treat for the taste buds but also a visual delight. To enhance the love-filled experience, the roll is elegantly topped with glistening salmon roe, adding a burst of color and flavor. Share the love with this uniquely shaped and delectable sushi roll.

2941151.name: Philedelphia Salmon Roll
2941151.description: 6 pcs - Philadelphia Salmon Roll: A luscious and savory sushi roll that captures the essence of Philadelphia flavors. This delectable roll typically features fresh salmon, smooth cream cheese, cucumber, and sometimes avocado, all rolled in seaweed and rice. The result is a delightful combination of rich, creamy textures and the natural taste of high-quality salmon. Enjoy the sophisticated and satisfying taste of our Philadelphia Salmon Roll.

1669749.name: Crispy Prawn Tempura Roll
1669749.description: 6 pcs - Crispy prawn tempura roll: A delectable combination of fried prawn, creamy avocado, and crispy fried egg wrapped in a roll, enhanced with cheese and a coating of golden breadcrumbs. Served with a delightful honey mustard sauce for a perfect blend of flavors and textures. Enjoy the unique and delicious experience of our crispy prawn tempura roll।

1669752.name: Green Dragon Roll
1669752.description: 6 pcs - A sushi delight featuring eel, avocado, and cucumber rolled in seaweed and rice. Topped with thin avocado slices to resemble dragon scales and drizzled with sweet sauce for a savory touch. The Green Dragon Roll offers a visually stunning presentation and a delicious combination of flavors in every bite

2941153.name: Beef Bulgogi Roll
2941153.description: 6 pcs - A Korean dish featuring thinly sliced and marinated beef bulgogi rolled with vegetables, creating a flavorful & savory delight

2941156.name: Salmon Logs Crispy Roll
2941156.description: 6 pcs - A fusion delight featuring avocado, salmon, and cheese inside, wrapped, fried to crispiness, and topped with honey mustard. The combination offers a unique blend of textures and flavors, from the richness of salmon and cheese to the creaminess of avocado, all enhanced by the sweet & tangy notes of honey mustard

2949168.name: Torched Crab Roll
2949168.description: 6 pcs -  Flavorful sushi creation filled with crab stick, avocado, cucumber wrapped in sushi rice - Topped with a layer of crab meat mixed with mayonnaise

2941159.name: California Roll
2941159.description: 6 pcs-  California Roll: A classic sushi roll that has stood the test of time, the California Roll features a filling of imitation crab or real crab, cucumber, and avocado, rolled in seaweed and rice. The roll is often served with pickled ginger, wasabi, and soy sauce for dipping.

2941149.name: Sweet Tiger Roll
2941149.description: 6 pcs - A decadent delight featuring a filling of creamy cheese, crispy fried prawn, and avocado. Topped with a luscious drizzle of sweet soy sauce and a satisfying crunch, this roll skips the nori for a unique twist on texture & flavor

1669726.name: Korean Style Seafood Soup
1669726.description: 1:1  - Korean Style Seafood Soup: Dive into the depths of Korean culinary delight with our seafood soup. Brimming with an assortment of fresh seafood like shrimp, clams, mussels, and squid, it features a rich broth infused with Korean spices, garlic, ginger, and gochugaru for a perfect balance of savory and slightly spicy flavors. Garnished with green onions and herbs, this Korean Style Seafood Soup promises a satisfying and comforting dining experience.

1669727.name: Miso Soup
1669727.description: 1:1  - Miso Soup: A classic Japanese dish that embodies simplicity and umami. Our Miso Soup features a delicate broth made with miso paste, which is fermented soybean paste. This comforting soup is often complemented with tofu cubes, seaweed (such as wakame), and sliced green onions. The result is a harmonious blend of savory and slightly salty flavors. Served hot and garnished with green onions.

1669728.name: Dak - Gae Jang
1669728.description: 1:1  -  Dak Gae Jang: A bold and hearty Korean dish, Dak Gae Jang is a spicy chicken stew that delights the palate with robust flavors. Tender pieces of chicken are simmered in a rich, spicy broth infused with garlic, ginger, and Korean chili paste. The stew is further enriched with soy sauce and sesame oil, creating a complex and savory profile. Garnished with green onions and sesame seeds, Dak Gae Jang is a comforting and satisfying dish that exemplifies the bold and spicy essence of Korean cuisine.

2965619.name: Thai Soup
2965619.description: 1:1  - Thai Soup (No Tofu, No High-Fen): Immerse yourself in the vibrant and aromatic flavors of our authentic Thai soup, crafted without tofu and free from high-fen ingredients. This savory and fragrant soup features a rich broth made with coconut milk, lemongrass, galangal, and Thai herbs. Choose your preferred protein, such as chicken or shrimp, and relish in the harmonious balance of sweetness, spiciness, and tanginess.

4748307.name: Kimchi Jjigae with Chicken
4748307.description: 1:1 - Kimchi Jjigae with Chicken: Experience the heartiness of Korean comfort food with our Kimchi Jjigae featuring tender chicken. This stew boasts the bold flavors of kimchi, tofu, and an array of vegetables simmered in a flavorful broth. The combination of spicy, savory, and tangy notes creates a soul-warming dish that embodies the essence of Korean cuisine.

2985007.name: Kimchi Jjigae With Beef
2985007.description: 1:1 - Experience the heartiness of Korean comfort food with our Kimchi Jjigae featuring tender beef. This stew boasts the bold flavors of kimchi, tofu, and an array of vegetables simmered in a flavorful broth. The combination of spicy, savory, and tangy notes creates a soul-warming dish that embodies the essence of Korean cuisine

2941172.name: Hot & Spicy Ramen
2941172.description: 1:1 - Spicy Sausage Ramen: Our bold and zesty Japanese noodle dish stars chewy ramen noodles in a savory, spicy broth with succulent sausage slices. Topped with green onions, it's a quick and hearty indulgence for spice lovers.

1669711.name: Soya Ramen
1669711.description: 1:1 - Soyo Ramen: Dive into the delectable world of Soyo Ramen, a savory delight featuring tender beef, a perfectly boiled egg, satay vegetables, and flavorful noodles in a rich soup. This comforting bowl harmonizes the hearty goodness of beef with the savory interplay of satay-infused vegetables, creating a satisfying and flavorful ramen experience.

1669713.name: Miso Ramen
1669713.description: 1:1 -  Chicken Miso Ramen: Revel in the comforting flavors of our Chicken Miso Ramen, where the richness of miso-flavored broth meets tender chicken. This Japanese noodle dish features chewy ramen noodles swimming in a savory broth crafted with fermented miso paste. Garnished with sliced chicken, green onions, seaweed, and optional additions like corn or bean sprouts, it offers a delightful balance of umami and hearty textures. Savor the warmth and wholesome taste of this chicken-infused twist on classic Japanese ramen.

1669714.name: Mixed Fried Noodles
1669714.description: Prepared with fried noodles with vegetable, shrimp, egg & chicken

3020643.name: Jajangmyeon with Chicken
3020643.description: 1:1  - Jajangmyeon with Chicken : Indulge in the Korean-Chinese fusion delight of Jajangmyeon, featuring a savory black bean sauce, tender chicken pieces, and fresh vegetables served over chewy wheat noodles.

3020644.name: Jajangmeyon with Beef
3020644.description: Beef Jajangmyeon: Delight in the Korean-Chinese fusion of Jajangmyeon, where chewy wheat noodles are generously coated in a savory black bean sauce, complemented by tender beef pieces and fresh vegetables.

7513847.name: Roasted Beef Ramen
7513847.description: 1:1 - Roasted Beef Ramen: Indulge in the savory goodness of our Roasted Beef Ramen, featuring succulent roasted beef, a perfectly cooked egg, and sautéed vegetables. This delightful bowl harmonizes the rich flavors of tender beef with the velvety texture of the egg and the freshness of sautéed vegetables, creating a satisfying and robust ramen experience.

7513848.name: Roasted Chicken Ramen
7513848.description: 1:1 - Roasted Chicken Ramen: Savor the deliciousness of our Roasted Chicken Ramen, prepared with tender roasted chicken, a perfectly cooked egg, and sautéed vegetables. This delightful bowl combines the savory notes of the chicken with the velvety texture of the egg and the freshness of sautéed vegetables, creating a comforting and flavorful ramen experience.

3001108.name: Beef Bulgogi Rice Bowl
3001108.description: Beef Bulgogi Rice Bowl: Succulent grilled beef bulgogi served over steamed rice, offering a delightful blend of sweet and savory flavors. Topped with sesame seeds and green onions, it's a quick and satisfying Korean culinary delight.

4748383.name: Seafood Bulgogi Rice Bowl
4748383.description: Seafood Bulgogi Rice Bowl: Grilled marinated seafood over steamed rice, a fusion of savory and marine flavors. Topped with sesame seeds and green onions for a quick and delightful Korean twist.

7513846.name: Chcken Bulgogi Rice Bowl
7513846.description: Chicken Bulgogi Rice Bowl: Grilled marinated chicken over steamed rice, offering a perfect blend of sweet and savory flavors. Topped with sesame seeds and green onions, it's a quick and satisfying twist on the classic Korean dish.

3069685.name: Fried Chicken Wings
3069685.description: 10 pcs - Crafted with precision , our korean fried chicken features tender , double fried chicken pieces coated in a luscious blend of soy sauce , garlic ginger and sesame oil.

3069686.name: Chicken Yakitori
3069686.description: 5 Sticks - Chicken yakitori is a Japanese dish of skewered and grilled chicken, brushed with a sweet soy-based sauce. Cooked over charcoal, the result is a delightful blend of smoky, tender chicken with a caramelized glaze.

3069687.name: Kimchi Jeon
3069687.description: Korean Pan Fried Kimchi Pan Cake made with fresh kimchi , seafood , eggs and vegetables.

3069688.name: Prawn Tempura with Crum
3069688.description: 6 pcs -  Made with Large Tiger Prawn & double fried with bread cram .

3069689.name: Calamari Ring
3069689.description: Deep fried Calamari Ring served with Tempura sauce .

3069690.name: Vegetable Tempura
3069690.description: Mixed Vegetable fried with  secret sauce and served with Tempura sauce .

3069691.name: Chicken Nan Bun
3069691.description: Crispy Chicken ( Leg meat ) dressed with special Nan Ban Sauce & Fresh Vegetables.

3069693.name: Bangkok Fried Chicken
3069693.description: 7 pcs - This Double fried crispy Chicken marinated with secret sauce served with Tomato Sauce .

3069694.name: Egg Roll
3069694.description: 8 Slices - Rolled with Egg and fresh Vegetables fried with secret Spcices. Served with Tepura sauce .

3069695.name: Chicken Cheese Roll
3069695.description: 6 pcs - Roll up with cheese , Chicken Breast & Depp fried with Bread - Crum.

4255464.name: Fish Finger
4255464.description: Fish fingers are bite-sized portions of breaded and usually baked or fried white fish fillets. Convenient and versatile, they are commonly served with dipping sauces and enjoyed as a quick and tasty snack or meal.

4257207.name: Mixed Tempura
4257207.description: Japananese traditional dish - Made with Prawn , Squid  & Vegetables .

3069710.name: Fish Cutlet
3069710.description: 8 slices - Made with fish , vegetables & spices .Coated in Eggs & breadcrumbs.

3069701.name: Mixed Seafood Clear Soup
3069701.description: Mixed seafood clear soup is a light and flavorful broth with a variety of fresh seafood, such as shrimp, squid, octopus and fish. The clear broth, possibly seasoned with herbs and spices, highlights the delicate natural flavors of the seafood, creating a savory and refreshing soup.

3069700.name: Vegetable Clear Soup
3069700.description: Vegetable clear soup is a light and nutritious broth filled with a medley of colorful vegetables. With a clear broth seasoned with herbs and spices, it offers a refreshing and healthful option that showcases the natural flavors of the veggies.

3069702.name: Miso Soup
3069702.description: Miso soup is a classic Japanese dish featuring a savory broth made from dashi and miso paste. Tofu, seaweed, and green onions are common additions, creating a simple yet comforting and flavorful soup, often enjoyed as a light meal or appetizer.

3069697.name: Thai Soup
3069697.description: 1:2 - Thai soup is a collection of flavorful and aromatic soups from Thailand, known for their unique blend of sweet, sour, salty, and spicy flavors. Popular varieties include Tom Yum, a hot and sour soup, and Tom Kha Gai, a coconut milk-based soup with chicken.

3069713.name: Spicy Beef Bulgogi
3069713.description: Spicy beef bulgogi is a Korean dish with thinly sliced beef marinated in a spicy mix of soy sauce, gochugaru, gochujang, garlic, ginger, and sugar. Stir-fried or grilled, it offers a bold and fiery twist to the traditional bulgogi, perfect for a flavorful meal served with rice and vegetables.

4257217.name: Beef Teriyaki
4257217.description: Beef teriyaki is a Japanese dish where thinly sliced beef is marinated and glazed with a sweet and savory teriyaki sauce. Grilled or pan-seared, it delivers a delicious combination of caramelized and tender beef, often served over rice or with vegetables.

3069719.name: Chicken Chilli Onion
3069719.description: Chicken Chili Onion, or Chilli Chicken, is a popular Indo-Chinese dish celebrated across India. It involves crispy fried chicken tossed in a spicy, tangy chili sauce, creating a fiery flavor. Prepared with onions, ginger, garlic, and flavorful sauces

3069705.name: Prawn Garlic
3069705.description: Prawn garlic is a flavorful dish featuring prawns cooked or sautéed with garlic, creating a rich and savory taste. Often simple yet delicious, it's celebrated for the delightful combination of seafood and the aromatic essence of garlic.

3069707.name: Beef Chili Onion
3069707.description: Beef Chili Onion, or Chilli Beef, is a popular Indo-Chinese dish in India. Tender beef, crisped and coated in a spicy, tangy chili sauce with onions, ginger, garlic, and assorted sauces. Enjoy it restaurant-style, perfect with fried rice or noodles.

3069711.name: Spicy Chicken Bulgogi
3069711.description: 1:1 - picy chicken bulgogi is a Korean dish featuring thinly sliced chicken marinated in a spicy mix of soy sauce, gochugaru, gochujang, garlic, ginger, and sugar. Stir-fried or grilled, it provides a bold and fiery twist to the traditional bulgogi, creating a flavorful meal served with rice and vegetables.

3069718.name: Chicken Kkanpunggi
3069718.description: Chicken Kkanpunggi is a popular Korean-Chinese dish featuring deep-fried chicken stir-fried with a spicy and garlicky sauce. It combines crispy chicken with savory and spicy flavors, often including vegetables. Enjoyed as a main dish, it pairs well with rice or noodles.

3069712.name: Prawn Tangsu
3069712.description: 1:1 - Prawn tangsu is a Korean dish featuring fish cooked in a sweet and sour sauce. The prawn is typically fried or breaded, and the tangsu sauce imparts a delightful balance of sweetness and tanginess to the dish.

3069715.name: Teriyaki Chicken
3069715.description: Chicken teriyaki is a Japanese dish with bite-sized chicken glazed in a sweet and savory teriyaki sauce. Whether grilled, baked, or pan-seared, it yields juicy, flavorful chicken with a caramelized finish.

3069717.name: Fish Tangsu
3069717.description: Fish tangsu is a Korean dish featuring fish cooked in a sweet and sour sauce. The fish is typically fried or breaded, and the tangsu sauce imparts a delightful balance of sweetness and tanginess to the dish.

4257212.name: Octopus BBQ
4257212.description: Korean-style octopus BBQ  involves grilling small octopus in a spicy gochujang-based sauce with garlic, ginger, soy sauce, and sugar. Known for its sweet, savory, and spicy flavors, this dish offers a unique and bold taste experience. Enjoyed with rice and side dishes, it's a popular choice in Korean seafood barbecue.

4257215.name: Squid BBQ
4257215.description: Korean-style squid BBQ features grilled or stir-fried squid in a gochujang-based sauce with garlic, ginger, soy sauce, and sugar. Balancing sweet, savory, and spicy flavors, it highlights the tender texture of the squid. A favorite in Korean barbecue, it's served with rice and side dishes for a unique and bold taste experience.

4257219.name: Crab Curry
4257219.description: Crab curry is a delightful dish featuring crab cooked in a flavorful curry sauce with spices, herbs, and aromatics like ginger, garlic, onions, and tomatoes.

7966590.name: Spicy Seafood Bulgogi
7966590.description: Spicy seafood bulgogi is a Korean delight featuring a mix of shrimp, squid, and octopus  marinated in a spicy-sweet blend of soy sauce, gochugaru, gochujang, honey, garlic, ginger, sesame oil, rice vinegar, and black pepper

4257218.name: Chicken Fried Rice
4257218.description: A signature & must have with all chinese items

9830220.name: Seafood Bulgogi Rice Bowl
9830220.description: 1:1 - Seafood Bulgogi Rice Bowl: Grilled marinated seafood over steamed rice, a fusion of savory and marine flavors Topped with sesame seeds and green onions for a quick and delightful Korean twist

9830222.name: Beef Bulgogi Rice Bowl
9830222.description: 1:1 - Beef Bulgogi Rice Bowl: Succulent grilled beef bulgogi served over steamed rice, offering a delightful blend of sweet and savory flavors Topped with sesame seeds and green onions, it's a quick and satisfying Korean culinary delight

4257213.name: Salmon Sashimi
4257213.description: 5 pcs slice - Salmon sashimi is a Japanese delicacy showcasing fresh, thinly sliced raw salmon. Often served as an appetizer or part of a sushi platter, it highlights the tender texture and rich flavor of the salmon. Accompanied by soy sauce, wasabi, and pickled ginger, salmon sashimi offers a delightful and pure seafood experience.

4257216.name: Tuna Sashimi
4257216.description: 5 slice - Tuna sashimi is a Japanese dish featuring fresh, thinly sliced raw tuna. Served as an appetizer or part of a sushi platter, it highlights the tuna's texture and flavor. Accompanied by soy sauce, wasabi, and pickled ginger, tuna sashimi is celebrated for its simplicity and the purity of the fish

3069740.name: Beef Maki
3069740.description: 6 pcs - Beef maki is a sushi roll made with cooked beef as a central ingredient. Alongside vinegared rice and seaweed, this variation introduces a savory twist to traditional sushi. The roll may include other complementary ingredients, offering a diverse flavor profile

3069739.name: Salmon Maki
3069739.description: 6 pcs -  Salmon maki is a sushi roll with vinegared rice, seaweed, and fresh salmon. This classic combination highlights the rich and tender flavor of the salmon, making it a popular and delicious choice among sushi options

3069738.name: Cucumber Maki
3069738.description: 6 pcs - Cucumber maki is a light and refreshing sushi roll with vinegared rice, seaweed, and cucumber as the main filling.

4257210.name: Tuna Maki
4257210.description: 6 pcs - Tuna maki is a classic sushi roll featuring vinegared rice, seaweed, and fresh tuna. Often complemented with ingredients like cucumber, avocado, or spicy mayo, it's a popular and flavorful choice in Japanese cuisine

3069734.name: Tuna Sushi Nigiri
3069734.description: 6 pcs Delicate rice topped with fresh tuna, served with wasabi & soy sauce for dipping

3069736.name: Salmon Sushi Nigiri
3069736.description: A type of sushi featuring a slice of raw salmon over a small bed of vinegared rice.

9830224.name: Mixed Nigiri
9830224.description:
"1:1 -  Nigiri sushis consisting of shrimp, salmon, tuna 
& cuttlefish"

3069750.name: Maguro Katsu Maki
3069750.description: 6 pcs - Maguro katsu maki, abundantly filled with tuna, features breaded and deep-fried tuna as a crispy centerpiece. Alongside vinegared rice and seaweed, this sushi roll is generously packed with tuna, both inside and as toppings. Additional elements like avocado, cucumber, and spicy mayo contribute to its rich and flavorful profile, creating a satisfying fusion of textures and tastes

3069752.name: Salmon katsu Maki
3069752.description: 6 pcs - Salmon katsu maki is a sushi roll that incorporates salmon katsu as a key component. Salmon katsu involves salmon that is breaded and deep-fried to achieve a crispy texture. The roll typically includes vinegared rice, seaweed, and additional ingredients such as avocado, cucumber, or sweet teriyaki sauce

3069749.name: Philadelphia Salmon Roll
3069749.description: 6 pcs - A Philadelphia salmon roll is a fusion sushi roll featuring smoked salmon, cream cheese, cucumber, and avocado. Combining traditional Japanese elements with flavors inspired by the Philadelphia roll, it offers a delightful blend of creaminess and smokiness, often served in sushi platters

3069753.name: Sweet Tiger Roll
3069753.description: 6 pcs - The Sweet Tiger Roll is a distinctive sushi roll without nori, featuring prawn, cheese, avocado, and a fried prawn inside. Drizzled with sweet soy sauce and topped with a crunchy element, it offers a fusion of savory, sweet, and crunchy flavors for a delightful sushi experience.

3069745.name: Crispy Chicken Fry Roll
3069745.description: 6 pcs - Crispy chicken fry sushi roll is a fusion delight, featuring vinegared rice, seaweed, and crispy fried chicken. Additional elements like vegetables and spicy mayo enhance the texture and flavor, providing a unique twist to the traditional sushi experience

3069748.name: Beef Bulgogi Roll
3069748.description: 6 pcs - Beef Bulgogi Roll is a fusion delight, featuring thinly sliced beef bulgogi, rice, and possibly vegetables rolled in seaweed. This creation combines the flavors of Korean barbecue with traditional Japanese sushi, offering a unique and savory experience.

3069743.name: Salmon Logs Crispy Roll
3069743.description: 6 pcs - Salmon Logs Crispy Roll: A fusion delight featuring avocado, salmon, and cheese inside, wrapped, fried to crispiness, and topped with honey mustard. The combination offers a unique blend of textures and flavors, from the richness of salmon and cheese to the creaminess of avocado, all enhanced by the sweet and tangy notes of honey mustard.

3069746.name: Dragon of Fire Roll
3069746.description: 6 Pcs - The Dragon of Fire Roll is a tantalizing sushi creation that sparks the senses. Inside, it boasts a fusion of avocado, cucumber, crab stick, and carrot. Topped with torched crab stick and carrot kima, the roll delivers a smoky and savory essence. Drizzled with spicy mayo and adorned with tobiko and green onions, this roll promises a fiery yet flavorful experience, combining creamy, crunchy, and torched elements for sushi enthusiasts.

3069754.name: Spicy Salmon Roll
3069754.description: 6 pcs - The Spicy Salmon Roll is a classic sushi favorite that packs a punch of flavor. Inside, it features fresh and succulent salmon combined with a spicy mayo sauce for heat. The roll may also include cucumber for added freshness. Wrapped in seaweed (nori) and vinegared rice, this roll offers a perfect balance of spiciness and the natural richness of salmon, making it a popular choice for sushi lovers.

3069742.name: Spicy Tuna Roll
3069742.description: 6 pcs - The Spicy Tuna Roll is a sushi favorite featuring a tantalizing blend of spicy tuna, spicy mayo, and sometimes cucumber or avocado. Wrapped in seaweed and vinegared rice, it delivers a perfect balance of heat and the rich flavor of tuna, making it a popular choice for sushi lovers.

3069755.name: Fresh Vegetable Roll
3069755.description: 6 pcs - The Fresh Vegetable Roll, rolled with rice paper, is a colorful and healthy sushi choice. Packed with crisp veggies like cucumber, carrot, lettuce, and avocado, it offers a light and refreshing texture. Served with a dipping sauce, it's a delightful option for those looking for a veggie-packed sushi experience.

3069747.name: Dragon Eye Roll
3069747.description: 6 pcs - The Dragon Eye Roll is a flavor-packed sushi delight, featuring boiled shrimp, tuna, avocado, salmon, and crab stick inside. Fried to a crispy perfection, it is topped with spicy mayo sauce, sriracha, and ebiko for a harmonious blend of savory, spicy, and crunchy elements. An indulgent and memorable sushi experience.

9830225.name: Sumo Roll

3069761.description: 6 pcs Lobster shrimp roll topped with minced spicy tuna, batter fried crunches, spicy mayo & flamed torched to add perfect flame grilled taste.

3069758.name: Torched Salmon Roll
3069758.description: 6 pcs Prepared with nori paper, sticky rice, slice cheese, crabstick, avocado, egg, cucumber, top side salmon & chili mayo

3069757.name: Tiger Roll

3069762.name: Torched Crab Roll
3069762.description: 6 pcs Sushi roll with crab filling, top lightly torched

3069760.name: California Roll
3069760.description: 6 pcs Shredded crabstic, cucumber & avocado rolled in a classic rice outside nori, sprinkled with sesame seed.

3069725.name: Jajangmyeon With Beef
3069725.description: Jajangmyeon with beef is a tasty twist on the classic Korean-Chinese dish. Featuring chewy noodles smothered in a savory black bean sauce, this variation includes stir-fried beef for added richness and depth of flavor.

3069724.name: Jajangmyeon With Chicken
3069724.description: Jajangmyeon with Chicken is a tasty twist on the classic Korean-Chinese dish. Featuring chewy noodles smothered in a savory black bean sauce, this variation includes stir-fried chicken for added richness and depth of flavor.

3069720.name: Mixed Fried Noodles
3069720.description: Mixed fried noodles is a versatile and delicious dish that combines an assortment of ingredients with stir-fried noodles, creating a flavorful and satisfying meal. Typically, various vegetables, proteins, and sometimes sauces are used to enhance the taste and texture of the noodles. This dish allows for creativity in ingredient selection, making it a popular and customizable choice.

3069727.name: Japchae With Chicken
3069727.description: Japchae with chicken is a flavorful Korean dish where sweet potato starch glass noodles are stir-fried with thinly sliced chicken, vibrant vegetables, and a savory sauce. This variation adds a protein-rich twist to the classic japchae, offering a delicious and well-balanced meal with a delightful combination of textures and flavors.

3069726.name: Hot Spicy Ramen
3069726.description: Spicy ramen with sausage and vegetables is a tasty fusion dish. The noodles swim in a bold, spicy broth, complemented by savory gravy, hearty sausages, and colorful vegetables. It's a flavorful and satisfying bowl that combines spice, richness, and a variety of textures.

3069721.name: Champong
3069721.description: Jampong is a Korean-Chinese seafood noodle soup, featuring a spicy broth filled with shrimp, squid, octopus and vegetables. The robust flavors of garlic, ginger, and gochugaru make it a bold and satisfying dish, perfect for those who enjoy the spicy and savory notes of Korean-Chinese cuisine.

3069771.name: Chicken Dumpling
3069771.description: 6 pcs Savory dumplings enveloping tender chicken, creating a comforting dish with rich flavors & satisfying textures

3069772.name: Beef Hargow
3069772.description: A variation of the classic shrimp dumpling (har gow), made with a beef filling instead.

3069764.description: Prepared with chicken mince & thin wrapper then steamed in dimsum style

3069770.name: Prawn Suimai

3065698.name: Shrimp Tempura
3065698.description: 6 pcs - Shrimp tempura is a popular Japanese dish featuring shrimp coated in a light tempura batter and deep-fried until crispy. To make it, clean and devein fresh shrimp, dip them in a cold tempura batter, and fry until golden brown. Serve with a dipping sauce, often made with soy sauce, mirin, and grated daikon radish.

3065697.name: Korean Fried Chicken
3065697.description: 7 pcs - Bangkok Fried Chicken: Marinate chicken in a mix of garlic, coriander, soy sauce, oyster sauce, fish sauce, and white pepper. Coat with cornstarch or rice flour and fry until golden brown. Serve hot with your favorite dipping sauce. Enjoy the crispy and flavorful Thai-style fried chicken!

3065693.name: Fried Chicken Wings
3065693.description: 5 pcs - Tender chicken wings, expertly seasoned & fried to perfect golden crispiness.

3088093.name: Fish Finger
3088093.description: Fish fingers are a popular convenience food made from boneless and skinless white fish fillets, coated in breadcrumbs, and typically served after being deep-fried or oven-baked.

3065692.name: Fried Crab
3065692.description: Crab is a dish where crabs are typically coated in a seasoned batter and deep-fried until crispy. The seasoning often includes a mix of garlic, ginger, soy sauce, and sometimes gochugaru (Korean red pepper flakes) for a hint of spice.

3065694.name: Squid Tempura
3065694.description: Squid tempura is a Japanese dish where squid is coated in a light tempura batter and deep-fried until crispy. To make it, clean and slice fresh squid, dip it in a cold tempura batter, and fry until golden brown. Serve with a dipping sauce made from soy sauce, mirin, and grated daikon radish

3065696.name: Fish Pan Cake
3065696.description: Fish Pan Cake : Korean pancake with sliced white fish, flour-cornstarch batter, fry until golden. Optional veggies. Enjoy as an appetizer or side dish!

3065699.name: Mixed Tempura
3065699.description: Mixed tempura is a Japanese dish consisting of squid rings, prawns, onions, capsicum, and various vegetables, all coated in a delicate, crispy batter and deep-fried until golden.

3065703.name: Fish Cutlet
3065703.description: A fish cutlet is a dish made by shaping seasoned fish mixture into patties, coating them with breadcrumbs, and frying or baking until golden brown.

3065710.name: Beef Bulgogi
3065710.description: Beef bulgogi is a Korean dish consisting of thinly sliced beef marinated in a sweet and savory sauce made with soy sauce, sugar, sesame oil, garlic, and pepper. The marinated beef is typically grilled or stir-fried, resulting in a flavorful and tender dish. It is often served with rice and vegetables.

3065701.name: Red Chili Prawn
3065701.description: Red chili prawns are a spicy and flavorful dish where prawns are typically cooked with a vibrant red chili-based sauce. The sauce often includes ingredients like red chili paste, garlic, ginger, soy sauce, and sometimes a touch of sweetness. The prawns are usually stir-fried or sautéed in this spicy and aromatic sauce, creating a deliciously fiery and savory dish.

3065711.name: Beef Teriyaki
3065711.description: 1:1 - Beef teriyaki is a Japanese dish featuring thinly sliced beef that is grilled or pan-fried and glazed with a glossy teriyaki sauce. The sauce typically consists of soy sauce, sake or mirin, sugar, and mirin, creating a sweet and savory flavor.

3065702.name: Chicken Teriyaki
3065702.description: 1:1 - Taste the harmony of sweet & savory chicken teriyaki glazed in signature teriyaki sauce

3065705.name: Dak Kkanjgeong
3065705.description: Dak Kangjeong is a Korean dish featuring bite-sized, deep-fried chicken glazed in a sweet and spicy sauce, commonly made with soy sauce, honey, garlic, ginger, and gochujang.

3065714.name: Octopus Bulgogi
3065714.description: Octopus bulgogi is a Korean dish that involves grilling or stir-frying marinated octopus. The octopus is typically seasoned with a flavorful bulgogi marinade, which includes ingredients like soy sauce, sugar, sesame oil, garlic, and other seasonings.

3065706.name: Red Chili Crab
3065706.description: Red chili crab is a popular Singaporean and Malaysian dish where crab is cooked in a spicy and flavorful sauce made with red chili paste, garlic, ginger, and various seasonings. The dish is known for its vibrant red color and bold, spicy taste. It is often enjoyed with steamed or fried buns to soak up the delicious sauce.

3065708.name: Prawn Thangsu
3065708.description: Prawn Tangsu is a Korean dish featuring battered and deep-fried shrimp served with a sweet and sour sauce. The shrimp are coated in a light batter, fried until crispy, and then glazed with a tangy sauce made from ingredients like vinegar, sugar, soy sauce, and ketchup.

3065712.name: Chicken Kkapunggi
3065712.description: Chicken Kkanpunggi is a Korean-Chinese dish known for its spicy and savory flavor. It typically features deep-fried chicken pieces coated in a sauce made with garlic, ginger, soy sauce, and chili flakes. Vegetables such as onions and bell peppers are often included, adding to the dish's texture and taste.

3065713.name: Chicken Tangsu
3065713.description: Chicken Tangsu - often known as sweet and sour chicken, is a Korean-Chinese dish. It involves crispy, deep-fried pieces of chicken coated in a tangy and sweet sauce made with ingredients such as vinegar, sugar, soy sauce, and fruit juices.

3065721.name: Chicken Bulgogi Rice Bowl
3065721.description: Spicy marinated chicken served over rice with vegetable & a savory sauce

3065722.name: Beef Bulgogi Rice Bowl
3065722.description: Savory marinated beef served over rice, topped with vegetable & a flavorful sauce

3065723.name: Seafood Bulgogi Rice Bowl
3065723.description: Savory marinated seafood served over rice, topped with vegetable & a flavorful sauce

3065715.name: Chicken Fried Rice
3065715.description: Chicken fried rice is a popular Asian dish made by stir-frying pre-cooked rice with diced chicken, vegetables, and seasonings. The dish typically includes ingredients like soy sauce, garlic, ginger, and sometimes peas, carrots, and onions.

3065716.name: Vegetable Fried Rice
3065716.description: 1:1 - Vegetable fried rice is a Chinese dish made by stir-frying cooked rice with vegetables like carrots, peas, and bell peppers. It includes scrambled or stir-fried eggs for added flavor and protein.

3065717.name: Garlic Fried Rice
3065717.description: 1:1 - Garlic fried rice is a dish where cooked rice is stir-fried with minced garlic until aromatic and lightly crispy. It's a simple and flavorful dish often seasoned with soy sauce, salt, and pepper. It can be enjoyed on its own or as a versatile side dish.

3065718.name: Sticky Rice
3065718.description: 1:1 - Sticky rice, also known as glutinous rice, is a type of rice with a high starch content that gives it a sticky and chewy texture when cooked. It is commonly used in various Asian cuisines.

3065719.name: Mixed Fried Rice
3065719.description: Mixed fried rice is a dish that combines cooked rice with a variety of ingredients such as chicken, egg, prawns, and vegetables. These components are stir-fried together, creating a flavorful and well-balanced dish. The rice is often seasoned with soy sauce and other seasonings to enhance the overall taste.

3065720.name: Kimchi Fried Rice
3065720.description: Kimchi fried rice is a delicious dish that combines the bold flavors of kimchi and the savory goodness of vegetables and egg . The dish is made by stir-frying cooked rice with kimchi, a fermented cabbage dish with spicy and tangy flavors.

3065746.name: Tuna Tartar Salad
3065746.description: Tuna tartare salad is a dish that involves finely diced or minced raw tuna, typically seasoned with ingredients like soy sauce, sesame oil, lime or lemon juice, and spices. This flavorful tuna tartare is often served on a bed of fresh greens, creating a delicious and refreshing salad.

3065747.name: Salmon Tartar Salad
3065747.description: Salmon tartare salad is a dish featuring raw, finely diced or minced salmon seasoned with ingredients like lime or lemon juice, olive oil, herbs, and spices. This salmon tartare is often served on a bed of fresh greens, creating a refreshing and flavorful salad.

3065727.name: Mixed Sushi Nigiri
3065727.description: 6pcs - Mixed nigiri features hand-pressed rice topped with fresh, raw tuna, shrimp, and salmon, offering a diverse and flavorful selection in Japanese sushi cuisine.

3065725.name: Tuna Sushi Nigiri
3065725.description: 6 pcs - Tuna nigiri is a type of sushi composed of a small, hand-pressed mound of vinegared rice topped with a slice of fresh, raw tuna. This classic sushi offering highlights the natural flavors of the tuna and the seasoned rice, often served with a dab of wasabi between the rice and fish.

3065726.name: Salmon Sushi Nigiri
3065726.description: 6 pcs - Salmon nigiri is a type of sushi that consists of a small bed of vinegared rice, typically hand-pressed, topped with a thin slice of fresh, raw salmon. It is often served with a dab of wasabi between the rice and fish, and occasionally garnished with a strip of seaweed (nori) to hold it together.

3065728.name: Tuna Sashimi
3065728.description: 5 slice - Tuna sashimi is a Japanese dish that features thinly sliced, fresh raw tuna served as a delicacy. The tuna is typically high-quality and is presented in an aesthetically pleasing manner.

3065729.name: Salmon Sashimi
3065729.description: 5 slices - Salmon sashimi is a Japanese dish consisting of thinly sliced, fresh raw salmon, presented as a delicacy. The salmon used for sashimi is of high quality, and it is often served in an aesthetically pleasing arrangement.

3065733.name: Salmon Maki
3065733.description: 6 pcs - Salmon maki is a type of sushi roll that typically includes vinegared rice, seaweed (nori), and fresh salmon. The ingredients are rolled together using a bamboo mat, and the roll is often filled with other components such as avocado, cucumber, or cream cheese. The roll is then sliced into bite-sized pieces.

3065738.name: Tuna Maki
3065738.description: 6 pcs - Tuna maki is a type of sushi roll that consists of vinegared rice, seaweed (nori), and fresh tuna as the main filling. The ingredients are rolled together using a bamboo mat, and the roll is often accompanied by other components such as cucumber or avocado. Once rolled, it is sliced into bite-sized pieces.

3065731.name: Salmon Philadelphia Roll
3065731.description: 6 pcs - Philadelphia Salmon Roll: A luscious and savory sushi roll that captures the essence of Philadelphia flavors. This delectable roll typically features fresh salmon, smooth cream cheese, cucumber, and sometimes avocado, all rolled in seaweed and rice.

3065735.name: Spicy Tuna Roll
3065735.description: 6pcs - Spicy Tuna Roll: A sushi classic with a spicy twist. Inside, enjoy a tantalizing blend of fresh tuna mixed with a fiery spicy mayo sauce, delivering a perfect harmony of heat and savory goodness. Encased in seaweed and rice, this roll offers a delightful kick for those who appreciate a bit of spice in their sushi.

3065737.name: Torched Crab Roll
3065737.description: 6 pcs - The Torched Roll is a flavorful sushi creation filled with crab stick and avocado, cucumber wrapped in sushi rice. Topped with a layer of crab meat mixed with mayonnaise, the roll is then carefully torched, creating a savory and visually appealing dish. The torching adds a smoky touch to the crab and enhances the overall taste of the roll

3065739.name: Rainbow California Roll
3065739.description: 6pcs - Rainbow California Roll: Experience a burst of colors and flavors with our Rainbow California Roll. This classic roll is crafted with a center of crab or imitation crab, cucumber, and avocado, wrapped in seaweed and rice. What sets it apart is the vibrant array of fresh sashimi-style fish, including tuna, salmon, and avocado, artfully arranged on top.

3065740.name: Spicy Salmon Roll
3065740.description: 6 pcs - Spicy Salmon Roll: A zesty and flavorful sushi roll that packs a punch. Inside, you'll find fresh and succulent salmon mixed with a spicy mayo sauce for a kick of heat. This delectable filling is wrapped in seaweed and rice, creating a perfect balance of spicy and savory flavors.

3065741.name: California Roll
3065741.description: 6 pcs- California Roll: A classic sushi roll that has stood the test of time, the California Roll features a filling of imitation crab or real crab, cucumber, and avocado, rolled in seaweed and rice. The roll is often served with pickled ginger, wasabi, and soy sauce for dipping.

3065742.name: Torched Salmon Roll
3065742.description: 6 pcs - The torched salmon roll features a core of crab stick, cucumber, and avocado, wrapped in seaweed and rice. Topped with fresh salmon, it is torched and drizzled with spicy mayo for a flavorful and textured sushi experience.

3065743.name: Dragon of Fire Roll
3065743.description: 6pcs - Dragon of Fire Sushi Roll: Ignite your taste buds with our Dragon of Fire Sushi Roll. Inside, revel in the harmony of creamy avocado, succulent crab stick, and crisp carrot, all enhanced with our signature sauce. Topped with a layer of torched crab stick and cucumber, this roll delivers a fiery sensation that will leave you enchanted.

3065744.name: Hot Night Roll
3065744.description: 6 pcs - Hot Night Roll: Dive into the vibrant flavors of our Summer Roll, a delightful combination of fried prawn, creamy cheese, avocado, and refreshing cucumber. Topped with luscious tuna and torched to perfection, it's crowned with a tantalizing spicy mayonnaise sauce.

3065745.name: Tiger Roll
3065745.description: 6pcs - Tiger Roll: Unleash the bold flavors of our Tiger Roll, featuring a delectable combination of creamy cheese, ripe avocado, crispy fried prawn, and refreshing cucumber. Topped with a luscious drizzle of honey mustard sauce and a sprinkle of ebiko (fish roe), this roll embodies the perfect balance of textures and tastes.

3086430.name: Spicy California Roll
3086430.description: 6 pcs - A Spicy California Roll is essentially a California Roll with added Sriracha or spicy sauce, providing a kick of heat to the classic combination of crab, avocado, and cucumber. Adjust the spice level to your preference and enjoy!

4257226.name: Volcano Roll
4257226.description: 6pcs - Volcano Roll: Indulge in the explosive flavors of our Volcano Roll, featuring succulent fried prawn, creamy avocado, and luscious cheese. Torched to perfection and generously drizzled with spicy mayonnaise sauce, this roll delivers a fiery kick. Topped with a crunchy eruption, our Volcano Roll is a symphony of textures and tastes that will ignite your taste buds.

7986808.name: Jjajangmyeon
7986808.description: Jjajangmyeon is a Korean-Chinese noodle dish featuring wheat noodles topped with a thick, savory black bean sauce. The sauce includes ingredients like meat, vegetables, and seafood, providing a rich and slightly sweet flavor.

7986809.name: Japche - Glass Noodles
7986809.description: Japchae is a Korean dish featuring sweet potato glass noodles stir-fried with a mix of colorful vegetables, Chicken and seasoned with a soy-sesame oil sauce. It's known for its chewy texture and delicious blend of flavors.

7986811.name: Mandu Ramen
7986811.description: Mandu Ramen is a dish featuring ramen noodles, 2 pieces of chicken mandu (dumplings), and additional ingredients like vegetables in a flavorful broth. It's a hearty and satisfying combination of ramen and dumplings.

3065757.name: Dak Gae Jung
3065757.description: 1:1 - Dak Gae Jang: A bold and hearty Korean dish, Dak Gae Jang is a spicy chicken stew that delights the palate with robust flavors. Tender pieces of chicken are simmered in a rich, spicy broth infused with garlic, ginger, and Korean chili paste. The stew is further enriched with soy sauce and sesame oil, creating a complex and savory profile.

3065759.name: Champong Soup
3065759.description: 1:1 - Kimchi Jjigae : Experience the heartiness of Korean comfort food with our Kimchi Jjigae . This stew boasts the bold flavors of kimchi, tofu, and an array of vegetables simmered in a flavorful broth. The combination of spicy, savory, and tangy notes creates a soul-warming dish that embodies the essence of Korean cuisine.

3065761.name: Spicy Seafood Soup
3065761.description: Savor the heat with our Spicy Seafood Soup. Loaded with a medley of fresh seafood such as shrimp, clams and squid, this soup boasts a fiery broth infused with spicy elements, garlic, ginger, and flavorful spices. A satisfying and bold choice for those craving a spicy and flavorful seafood experience.

7986807.name: Miso Soup
7986807.description: Miso soup is a traditional Japanese dish with a broth made from dashi, enriched with miso paste. It commonly includes tofu, seaweed, and green onions, offering a light and savory starter in Japanese cuisine.

4365489.description: 6 pcs - Sae Tuigim: Korean-style deep-fried shrimp - crispy, seasoned batter showcasing the natural sweetness of the shrimp. Perfect as an appetizer with dipping sauces.

4365485.name: Yang Nyeom Chicken
4365485.description: 10 pcs - Yang Nyeom Chicken: Korean fried chicken tossed in a spicy, flavorful sauce featuring gochujang, garlic, ginger, and soy sauce. Enjoy the perfect balance of crispy and spicy goodness.

4365482.name: Dak Gang Jeon
4365482.description: Dak Gang Jeon is Korean Fried Chicken crispy, seasoned chicken fried to perfection and coated in a savory-sweet glaze. A delightful combination of crunch and flavor.

4365486.name: Korean Fried Chicken
4365486.description: 10 pcs  - Korean-style Fried Chicken is a crispy delightgolden-fried chicken coated in a savory sauce infused with soy, garlic, and ginger. It's a perfect harmony of crunch and bold flavor.

4365494.name: Haemul Pajeon - Seafood Pancake
4365494.description: Haemul Pajeon: Korean Seafood Pancake savory pancake with shrimp, squid, and green onions, pan-fried to golden perfection. Served with a soy-based dipping sauce for a delightful blend of flavors.

4365488.name: Chicken Kkanpunggi
4365488.description: Chicken Kkanpunggi: A Korean-Chinese delight deep-fried chicken stir-fried in a spicy garlic sauce with bell peppers and onions. A perfect blend of crispy, tender, sweet, and spicy flavors.

4365490.name: Mixed Tempura
4365490.description: Mixed Tempura: A Japanese delight with an assortment of seafood and vegetables dipped in a light, crispy batter and deep-fried. Served with a dipping sauce for a satisfying mix of textures and flavors.

4365507.name: Haemul Kimchi Jeon - Seafood Kimchi Pancake
4365507.description: Haemul Kimchi Jeon: Korean Seafood Kimchi Pancake-flavorful batter with kimchi and assorted seafood, pan-fried to golden perfection. Served with a soy-based dipping sauce for a delightful blend of tastes and textures.

4365504.name: Kimchi Jeon - Kimchi Pan Cake
4365504.description: Kimchi Jeon, or Kimchi Pancake, is a beloved Korean dish made by pan-frying a batter of flour, water, and eggs mixed with kimchi. The result is a savory and crispy pancake with the distinct tangy and spicy flavor of kimchi. Kimchi Jeon is often enjoyed as a tasty and satisfying snack or appetizer, typically served with a dipping sauce.

4365500.name: Tofu Jeon - Tofu Pan Cake
4365500.description: Tofu Jeon: Korean Tofu Pancake - soft inside, crispy outside. Crafted with tofu, flour, water, and eggs, seasoned with green onions. Served with a dipping sauce for a tasty and versatile delight.

4365499.name: Gyeran Mari  - Egg Roll
4365499.description: Gyeran Mari: Korean rolled omelette, a simple and versatile dish made with whisked eggs and vegetables. Sliced into rounds, it's a popular side dish in Korean cuisine.

4365501.name: Fried Crab
4365501.description: Fried Crab : Crab seasoned and deep-fried to perfection, offering a delightful combination of crispy texture and savory flavor - a delicious choice in Korean seafood cuisine.

4365513.name: Beef Teriyaki
4365513.description: Beef Teriyaki: Tender strips of beef glazed in a savory-sweet teriyaki sauce, offering a delicious harmony of flavors. A popular and satisfying dish in Japanese cuisine.

4365515.name: Tteok - Bokki with Chicken Mandu
4365515.description: Tteok-bokki with fried chicken mandu is a popular Korean dish. Tteok-bokki consists of chewy rice cakes in a spicy and sweet gochujang-based sauce. The addition of fried chicken mandu, or dumplings, complements the dish with savory and crispy textures. It's a delightful and flavorful street food often enjoyed for its spicy kick and satisfying combination of rice cakes and fried dumplings.

4365487.name: Chicken Teriyaki
4365487.description: Chicken Teriyaki: Succulent chicken glazed in a sweet and savory teriyaki sauce, creating a delightful blend of flavors. A popular and satisfying dish in Japanese cuisine.

4365484.name: Chicken Tangsu - Sweet & Sour Chicken
4365484.description: Chicken Tangsu: Korean-Chinese Sweet and Sour Chicken - crispy fried pieces glazed in a perfect blend of sweet and tangy sauce. A delightful fusion of flavors and textures.

4365514.name: Beef Tangsu - Sweet & Sour Beef
4365514.description: Beef Tangsu: Korean-Chinese sweet and sour beef - tender slices fried and coated in a flavorful balance of sweetness and tanginess. A delicious blend of textures and tastes.

4365508.name: Garlic Mushroom
4365508.description: Garlic Mushrooms: Plump mushrooms sautéed in a rich blend of garlic-infused butter, creating a simple yet deeply flavorful dish perfect as a side or appetizer. The aromatic combination of garlic and butter enhances the earthy essence of the mushrooms, making it a delightful addition to any meal.

4365503.name: Prawn Tangsu
4365503.description: Prawn Tangsu: Succulent prawns coated in a sweet and tangy sauce, offering a delightful fusion of flavors. A Korean-Chinese dish with crispy texture and vibrant taste.

4411047.name: Beef Bulgogi Dop Bap
4411047.description: 1:1 - Prepared with thinly sliced grilled beef marinated in a flavorful blend of soy sauce, sugar, garlic, ginger & sesame oil, served over bed of rice

4411048.name: Dolsot Bibim Bap

4411046.name: Oh Jhingeo Dolsot Bibim Bap
4411046.description: 1:1 - Prepared with seasoned rice, mixed with various vegetable & topped with spicy marinated ohjhingeo squid

4411044.name: Kimchi Bokkeum Bap
4411044.description: 1:1 - Kimchi fried rice prepared with stir frying along with vegetable & poached egg

4411045.name: Seafood Jajang Bap
4411045.description: 1:1 - Prepared with a savory black bean sauce, stir-fried with an assortment of shrimp, squid & octopus, served over bed of steamed rice

4411057.name: Omelette Rice
4411057.description: Omelette Rice is a Japanese dish that consists of fried rice enveloped in a thin omelette. The fried rice is commonly flavored with ingredients like vegetables, chicken, or beef and seasoned with ketchup. The omelette is partially cooked and then folded over the rice, creating a delicious and visually appealing dish.

4411050.name: Seafood Fried Rice
4411050.description: Seafood Fried Rice: A savory blend of fluffy rice, shrimp, crab, or fish, and vibrant vegetables. Stir-fried to perfection with soy sauce and spices, it's a delicious medley of seafood flavors and textures.

4365509.name: Spicy Seafood Bulgogi
4365509.description: Spicy Seafood Bulgogi is a Korean dish featuring a marinade with soy sauce, gochujang, sesame oil, honey, garlic, ginger, rice vinegar, and red pepper flakes. Seafood and optional vegetables are marinated - garnish with green onions and sesame seeds, and serve over rice or noodles. Adjust spice level to taste.

4365510.name: Spicy Beef Bulgogi
4365510.description: Spicy Beef Bulgogi is a Korean dish featuring a marinade with soy sauce, gochujang, sesame oil, honey, garlic, ginger, and red pepper flakes. Thinly sliced beef is marinated and then grilled or cooked in a skillet for a savory, sweet, and spicy flavor. Serve over rice or in lettuce wraps, garnished with green onions and sesame seeds. Adjust spice level to taste.

4365512.name: Spicy Chicken Bulgogi
4365512.description: Spicy Chicken Bulgogi is a Korean dish featuring a marinade with soy sauce, gochujang, sesame oil, honey, garlic, ginger, and red pepper flakes. Chicken pieces are marinated, grilled or cooked until caramelized, and served over rice or in wraps. Garnish with green onions and sesame seeds.

4365505.name: Spicy Squid & Octopus Bulgogi
4365505.description: Spicy Squid & Octopus Bulgogi is a Korean dish featuring a marinade with soy sauce, gochujang, sesame oil, honey, garlic, ginger, and red pepper flakes. Squid and octopus are marinated and grilled until tender. Serve over rice or noodles, garnished with green onions and sesame seeds.

4365498.name: Squid Bulgogi
4365498.description: Squid Bulgogi is a Korean dish featuring squid marinated in a mixture of soy sauce, gochujang, sesame oil, honey, garlic, ginger, and red pepper flakes. Grill or cook until tender, then serve over rice or noodles. Garnish with green onions and sesame seeds, adjusting the spice level to taste.

4365493.name: Octopus Bulgogi
4365493.description: Octopus Bulgogi is a Korean dish where octopus is marinated in a flavorful mixture of soy sauce, gochujang (Korean red pepper paste), sesame oil, honey, garlic, ginger, and red pepper flakes. Grill or cook until tender, then serve over rice or noodles. Garnish with green onions and sesame seeds, adjusting the spice level to taste.

4365497.name: Spicy Haemul Bokom
4365497.description: Spicy Haemul Bokkeum is a Korean seafood stir-fry with shrimp, squid, and mussels. It features a spicy sauce with gochujang, soy sauce, sesame oil, garlic, and ginger. Serve over rice or noodles, adjusting the spice level to taste.

4365496.name: Palbo Cahe
4365496.description: Consists of stir fried seafood with vegetable

4365527.name: Salmon Dadiki Salad
4365527.description: Salmon Tataki Salad features salmon that is lightly seared on the outside for a delicate crust while keeping the inside raw. Served on fresh greens with a tangy dressing, it combines the richness of the salmon with the crispness of the salad.

4365531.name: Yulingi Crispy Chicken Salad
4365531.description: Lingi Crispy Chicken Salad features thinly sliced chicken deep-fried with a secret masala, served alongside fresh vegetables as a dressing.

4365526.name: Tuna Dadiki Salad
4365526.description: Tuna Tataki Salad is a Japanese dish featuring lightly seared tuna slices on fresh greens. The tuna is seared on the outside, leaving the inside raw. It's served with a flavorful dressing, such as soy-based or citrusy ponzu, and may include toppings like sesame seeds and green onions for added texture and taste.

4365529.name: Seafood Salad
4365529.description: Seafood salad is a harmonious blend of boiled shrimp, crab, squid, and octopus, along with glass noodles and crisp vegetables. What sets it apart is the bespoke tangy dressing, enhancing the freshness of the seafood.

4365530.name: Boiled Chicken Salad
4365530.description: Boiled chicken salad features tender chicken on a bed of fresh greens and vegetables, seasoned with herbs and spices. Customize with toppings and dressing for a light, nutritious meal.

4365528.name: Chicken Cashewnut Salad
4365528.description: Chicken Cashew Nut Salad combines tender chicken, crunchy cashews, and fresh vegetables. The salad is enriched with vibrant greens and a flavorful dressing, creating a balanced and satisfying meal.

4365516.name: Yuk Gae Jang
4365516.description: Yuk Gae Jang is a spicy Korean soup with shredded beef, vegetables, and glass noodles in a flavorful broth made with gochugaru. Seasoned with soy sauce, garlic, and sesame oil, it's a hearty and warming dish.

4365518.name: Doenjang-jjigae
4365518.description: Doenjang-jjigae is a Korean stew featuring fermented soybean paste, tofu, vegetables, and optionally meat or seafood. Seasoned with garlic and soy sauce, it offers a rich and savory flavor, often served with rice.

4365521.name: Spicy Mixed Seafood Soup
4365521.description: Spicy Mixed Seafood Soup is a flavorful dish that combines various seafood, such as shrimp, squid  in a spicy broth. The soup often includes an assortment of vegetables, like onions, mushrooms, and green onions. The spiciness comes from ingredients like chili flakes or chili paste.

4365523.name: Spicy Seafood Noodles Soup
4365523.description: Spicy Seafood Noodle Soup is a dish featuring a mix of seafood, like shrimp, squid in a spicy broth served with noodles. The soup is known for its bold and flavorful combination of spicy and savory elements, making it a popular choice for those who enjoy a kick of heat with their seafood.

4365517.name: Seafood Doenjang-jjigae
4365517.description: Seafood Doenjang-jjigae is a Korean stew blending fermented soybean paste with seafood like shrimp, clams, and squid. Enriched with vegetables, it creates a savory broth seasoned with garlic and soy sauce. Typically served with rice, it's a comforting and popular dish in Korean cuisine.

4365522.name: Kimchi Jjigae with Beef
4365522.description: Kimchi Jjigae with Beef is a Korean stew that combines kimchi, beef, tofu, and various vegetables. The main components are kimchi and beef, creating a rich and flavorful broth. The stew is often seasoned with gochugaru (Korean red pepper flakes), garlic, and soy sauce. Kimchi Jjigae with Beef is known for its spicy and tangy taste, and it's a popular comfort food in Korean cuisine. It is usually served with a bowl of rice.

4365524.name: Kimchi Jjigae with Chicken
4365524.description: Kimchi Jjigae with Chicken is a variation of the classic Korean stew that usually features kimchi, chicken, tofu, and vegetables. The dish is known for its robust and flavorful broth created by the combination of fermented kimchi and chicken. Gochugaru (Korean red pepper flakes) and other seasonings add spice and depth to the stew. It's a comforting and satisfying dish, often enjoyed with a side of rice.

4365520.name: Dak Gae Jang
4365520.description: Dak Gae Jang, also known as Spicy Korean Chicken Stew, is a flavorful dish where fresh chicken is simmered in a spicy broth. The broth is crafted with soy sauce, sesame oil, garlic, ginger, and Korean red pepper flakes (gochugaru), providing a bold and spicy flavor. Often featuring green onions and other vegetables, this hearty stew is enjoyed for its rich taste and is commonly served with rice for a satisfying meal.

4365525.name: Miso Soup
4365525.description: Miso Soup is a traditional Japanese soup with a savory broth made from fermented soybean paste (miso). It typically includes tofu, seaweed, and green onions, offering a simple and comforting dish.

4365519.name: Miyeok Soup
4365519.description: Miyeok Soup, or Korean Seaweed Soup, is a traditional dish featuring miyeok seaweed simmered in a flavorful broth with ingredients like beef or anchovy stock, garlic, and soy sauce. It is often enriched with tofu, vegetables, and sometimes protein, providing a nourishing and mild-flavored soup.

4365532.name: Japchae
4365532.description: Korean glass noodles with veggies & sesame oil

4365535.name: Jajangmyeon With Chicken
4365535.description: Jajangmyeon with chicken is a fusion dish combining the classic Korean-Chinese black bean noodles with tender chicken. The result is a hearty and satisfying meal with rich and savory flavors.

4365537.name: Tteok Mandu Guk
4365537.description: Tteok Mandu Guk is a traditional Korean soup with rice cake slices (tteok) and dumplings (mandu) in a clear broth, symbolizing good luck. Seasoned with garlic, soy sauce, and sesame oil, it offers a comforting and flavorful experience

4365540.name: Beef Bulgogi Fried Noodles
4365540.description: Beef Bulgogi Fried Noodles is a delightful Korean dish where tender slices of marinated beef, known as bulgogi, are stir-fried with noodles. The bulgogi marinade typically includes soy sauce, sugar, sesame oil, garlic, and other seasonings, imparting a sweet and savory flavor to the beef. Mixed with noodles, this dish becomes a flavorful and satisfying fusion of Korean and stir-fry cuisine, offering a delicious combination of textures and tastes.

4365542.name: Mixed Fried Noodles
4365542.description: Mixed Fried Noodles that made with Korean spices is a flavorful dish that combines a medley of ingredients. It features stir-fried noodles with chicken, shrimp, assorted vegetables, and eggs. The Korean spices bring a unique and savory twist to the dish, creating a delicious fusion of textures and flavors in every bite.

4365539.name: Hot Spicy Ramen
4365539.description: Hot Spicy Ramen is a popular and fiery Japanese noodle dish known for its intense spiciness. It typically consists of Chinese-style wheat noodles served in a broth made with chili oil, sausages , soy sauce, miso, and other seasonings. This is not a soup noodles its gravy .

4365534.name: Shin Ramen
4365534.description: Shin Ramen is a renowned South Korean instant noodle brand celebrated for its bold and spicy flavor profile. After cooking, enthusiasts often customize their Shin Ramyun by adding eggs. Whether poached in the hot broth or separately prepared, the eggs contribute a delightful richness to the noodles, enhancing the overall taste and texture of this popular and convenient dish.

4365538.name: Mandu Ramen
4365538.description: Mandu Ramen is a Korean fusion dish pairing ramen noodles with savory dumplings (mandu) in a flavorful broth. Combining the comfort of noodles with the deliciousness of dumplings, it creates a hearty and satisfying bowl.

4365536.name: Soya Ramen
4365536.description: Soy Ramen is a savory noodle dish featuring a rich broth made with soy paste, complemented by a mix of fresh vegetables, eggs, and tender beef. The dish is completed with hearty noodles, creating a satisfying and flavorful bowl that combines the umami goodness of soy with the comforting elements of ramen.

4365551.name: California Roll
4365551.description: 8 pcs - California Roll: A timeless classic, our California Roll boasts a delectable blend of imitation or real crab, crisp cucumber, and creamy avocado, expertly rolled in seaweed and rice. Served with pickled ginger, wasabi, and soy sauce on the side, this roll delivers a delightful fusion of flavors and textures in every bite.

4365552.name: Beef Kimbap
4365552.description: 8 pcs - Beef Kimbap is a Korean roll with seasoned beef, vegetables, and pickled radish wrapped in seaweed and rice. Sliced for convenience, it delivers a savory and balanced flavor in every bite.

4365555.name: Salmon Sushi Nigiri
4365555.description: 8 pcs -  Salmon Nigiri is a classic Japanese sushi dish consisting of a small hand-pressed mound of vinegared rice topped with a slice of fresh salmon. The simplicity of this sushi allows the delicate flavor of the salmon to shine. It is often served with a dab of wasabi between the rice and fish, and occasionally garnished with a thin strip of seaweed (nori).

4365556.name: Tuna Kimbap
4365556.description: 8 pcs - Tuna Kimbap is a Korean dish that involves seasoned tuna, vegetables, and pickled radish rolled in seaweed and rice. Similar to other kimbap varieties, it is a convenient and flavorful way to enjoy a balanced mix of ingredients in a portable roll. Tuna Kimbap is often sliced into bite-sized pieces for easy consumption, offering a tasty and satisfying snack or meal.

4365554.name: Tuna Sushi Nigiri
4365554.description: 8 pcs - Tuna Sushi Nigiri is a classic Japanese sushi consisting of bite-sized, hand-pressed mounds of vinegared rice topped with fresh tuna. The tuna is typically sliced thinly and draped over the rice. It's often served with a small amount of wasabi between the rice and fish, offering a delightful combination of tender tuna and seasoned rice.

4365533.name: Baechu Kimchi
4365533.description:
300 gm - 
Baechu Kimchi is a classic Korean dish of fermented Napa cabbage. The cabbage is seasoned with a paste containing gochugaru, garlic, ginger, and fish sauce, creating a spicy, tangy, and flavorful condiment that is a staple in Korean cuisine.

4365548.name: Beef Sui-Mai
4365548.description: 6 pcs -Beef Sui Mai is a  dim sum featuring seasoned ground beef encased in a thin dumpling wrapper. This savory variation is commonly enjoyed with dipping sauces like soy sauce or chili oil.

4365544.name: Beef Mandu
4365544.description: 6 pcs - Beef Mandu is a Korean dumpling filled with seasoned ground beef and vegetables, offering a savory taste. These dumplings are commonly boiled, steamed, or pan-fried and are often served with dipping sauces for added flavor.

4365547.name: Chicken Mandu
4365547.description: 6 pcs - Chicken Mandu is a Korean dumpling with seasoned ground chicken and vegetables, enclosed in a thin dough. These savory dumplings are cooked through boiling, steaming, or pan-frying, and commonly served with dipping sauces.

4365543.name: Prawn Har-Gow
4365543.description: 6 pcs - Prawn Hargow is a Cantonese dim sum featuring translucent dumpling wrappers filled with minced or whole shrimp. Steamed to perfection, these dumplings showcase the vibrant pink color of the prawns, offering a delicate and juicy texture in each bite.

4365557.name: Beef Har-Gow
4365557.description: 6 pcs - Har Gow is a Cantonese dim sum featuring translucent dumpling wrappers filled with minced or whole shrimp, showcasing a delicate and juicy texture. It's a classic dish known for its shrimp filling, not typically made with beef.

4365546.name: Chicken Har-Gow
4365546.description: 6 pcs - Har Gow is a Cantonese dim sum with translucent wrappers filled with minced or whole shrimp. While traditionally made with shrimp, there isn't a common version with chicken filling. For chicken-filled dumplings, you might explore other dim sum options like Chicken Shumai.

4365549.name: Prawn Sui-Mai
4365549.description: 6 pcs - Prawn Sui Mai is a classic Cantonese dim sum featuring open-faced dumplings filled with a mixture of minced or whole prawns, sometimes combined with pork and various seasonings. These dumplings are typically topped with a small piece of roe or garnish and are steamed to perfection.

4365545.name: Chicken Sui-Mai
4365545.description: 6 pcs - Chicken Sui Mai is a Cantonese dim sum variation with minced chicken, seasonings, and sometimes shiitake mushrooms or water chestnuts. These open-faced dumplings are steamed, offering a delightful blend of flavors and textures.
