9711102.name: Milk Bread
9711102.description: Soft and fluffy milk bread with a delicate crumb texture and subtle sweetness. Baked fresh daily using premium milk and finest ingredients for a tender mouthfeel. Perfect for breakfast or as a light snack.

9711103.name: Butter Bun
9711103.description: Soft and fluffy butter bun with a golden exterior and rich buttery flavor. Perfect for breakfast or as a delightful snack with tea or coffee.

9711106.name: German Bread
9711106.description: Authentic German bread crafted with traditional methods featuring a hearty dense crumb and perfectly crispy crust. Baked fresh daily using premium flour and natural ingredients for a rich wholesome flavor that pairs beautifully with any meal

9711109.name: Motor Dal
9711109.description: Premium quality Motor Dal with smooth texture and rich nutritional value Perfect for everyday cooking and traditional Bengali cuisine Sourced and processed with care for authentic taste

9711110.name: BBQ Chanachur
9711110.description: Savory BBQ flavored chanachur with a perfect blend of spices and smoky taste. Crispy and crunchy snack mix ideal for tea time or any occasion

9711111.name: Special Chanachur
9711111.description: Crispy and savory chanachur mix featuring roasted chickpeas peanuts and spiced lentils Perfect for snacking or serving as an appetizer at gatherings

9711114.name: Potato Chanachur
9711114.description: Crispy potato chanachur seasoned with aromatic spices and herbs. A delightful savory snack perfect for tea time or as a light bite anytime

9711117.name: Salty Monakka
9711117.description: Premium salty monakka offering a delightful blend of sweet and savory flavors Perfect for snacking or enjoying with tea A traditional favorite that brings authentic taste to your table

9711118.name: Bela Biscuit
9711118.description: Crispy and delicious Bela biscuits perfect for tea time or as a light snack. These traditional biscuits are made with quality ingredients and offer a satisfying crunch with every bite

9711119.name: Mithai Baby Toast
9711119.description: Mithai Baby Toast is a delightful dry snack featuring crispy toasted bread pieces with a subtle sweet flavor. Perfect for breakfast or as a light snack throughout the day.

9711123.name: Mithai Lacha Semai - 200 gm
9711123.description: Delicate and crispy Mithai Lacha Semai in a convenient 200 gm pack. This traditional Bengali sweet treat features thin strands of vermicelli layered with ghee and jaggery for an authentic taste of home

9711125.name: Mithai Premium Butter Cookies - ATC
9711125.description: Premium butter cookies crafted with finest quality ingredients offering a delightful blend of rich buttery flavor and crispy texture Perfect for tea time snacking or gifting to loved ones

9711126.name: Mithai Premium Ovaltin Cookies - ATC
9711126.description: Delicious Mithai Premium Ovaltin Cookies with rich malt flavor and crispy texture. Perfect for tea time snacking or gifting. Each bite delivers authentic taste and premium quality.

9711127.name: Mithai Premium Shortbread Cookies - ATC
9711127.description: Premium shortbread cookies with a delicate buttery texture and rich golden flavor. These classic treats are perfectly crispy on the outside and tender within, ideal for tea time or as a delightful gift.

9711130.name: Mithai Premium Butter Toast - ATC
9711130.description: Premium butter toast with a rich golden crust and delightful sweetness. Each bite offers a perfect combination of crispy texture and smooth buttery flavor. Ideal for tea time or as a delicious snack throughout the day.

9711131.name: Mithai Premium Garlic Toast - ATC
9711131.description: Crispy golden garlic toast with premium quality ingredients and aromatic garlic flavoring. Perfect as a snack or accompaniment to your favorite dishes

9711132.name: Mithai Premium Sugar Free Toast - ATC
9711132.description: 1:1 - Crispy, wholesome slices with a light, balanced taste in every bite

9711133.name: Mithai Chocolate Dry Cake Bucket

9711134.name: Mithai Milk Salt Cookies Bucket
9711134.description: 250 gm - Crispy, lightly salted cookies with a smooth milky flavor and satisfying crunch in every bite

9711135.name: Mithai Nankhatai Cookies Bucket
9711135.description: 300 gm - Traditional, buttery, and delicately sweet cookies with a rich, melt-in-your-mouth texture in every bite

9711136.name: Mithai Plain Dry Cake Bucket
9711136.description: 250 gm - Soft, lightly sweet, and perfectly baked for a simple, comforting treat in every bite

6234106.name: Naga Chicken Wings
6234106.description: 10 pcs - Spicy chicken wings inspired by Naga cuisine, featuring a fiery sauce with Naga chili peppers for intense heat. Grilled or baked, they offer a bold and flavorful kick.

1669738.name: Yangnyeom Chicken
1669738.description: 7 pcs - Yangnyeom Chicken is a Korean dish featuring crispy fried chicken coated in a sweet and spicy sauce. The sauce typically includes gochujang (Korean red chili paste), soy sauce, garlic, ginger, creating a flavorful combination.

1669731.name: Haemul Pajeon
1669731.description: Haemul Pajeon is a Korean savory pancake that features a variety of seafood (haemul) and green onions (pajeon) mixed into a batter and pan-fried until golden and crispy.

1669737.name: Korean Style Fried Chicken
1669737.description: 7 pcs - Golden-brown perfection: tender, juicy chicken with a seasoned & crunchy crust, served with tomato sauce

1669729.name: Mixed Tempura
1669729.description: Prepared with squid, prawn, vegetable & onion

1669735.name: Crispy Prawn Tempura
1669735.description: 6 pcs  - Crispy prawn tempura is a Japanese dish where prawns are coated in a thin, crisp layer and deep-fried until golden.

2941076.name: Chicken Yakitori
2941076.description: 5 sticks - Chicken yakitori is a Japanese dish featuring skewered and grilled chicken. The chicken is typically seasoned with a savory-sweet soy-based sauce, resulting in a flavorful and slightly caramelized exterior.

6234104.name: Chicken Lollipop
6234104.description: 6pcs - Chicken lollipops are a popular appetizer made from chicken wings. The meat is cut, pushed down to create a lollipop-like appearance, and then marinated with spices. It's often coated in a batter and deep-fried until crispy.

2941079.name: Chicken Nan Bun
2941079.description: Chicken Nanban is a Japanese dish consisting of crispy fried chicken topped with a sweet and sour soy-based sauce. The dish often includes a side of tartar sauce and is served with a bed of shredded cabbage. The combination of crunchy chicken and flavorful sauce makes it a popular and delicious option in Japanese cuisine.

3001106.name: Egg Roll
3001106.description: 8 Slice - Gyeran Mari, also known as an egg roll, is a Korean dish made by rolling seasoned beaten eggs around various ingredients. These ingredients can include vegetables like carrots, bell peppers, and green onions.

2941077.name: Fried  Wonton
2941077.description: 6 pcs - Fried wontons are a delightful Chinese appetizer made by filling wonton wrappers with a savory mixture, often containing minced  shrimp, and then deep-frying until golden and crispy.

2941078.name: Chicken Cheese Roll
2941078.description: 6 pcs- Chicken cheese roll involves seasoned chicken rolled with cheese, coated in egg and bread crumbs, then fried until golden and crispy

7610319.name: Chicken Satay
7610319.description: 5 slice - Delicious chicken satay skewers marinated with spice - Served with peanut butter sauce

7610323.name: Fried Chicken with BBQ Sauce
7610323.description: 7 pcs - Fresh fried chicken, drizzled with tangy bbq sauce

7610324.name: Fried Chicken Wings
7610324.description: 7 pcs - Tender chicken wings, expertly seasoned & fried to perfect golden crispiness

2974408.name: Kimchi Jeon
2974408.description: 1:1 - Beef Kimbap is a delicious Korean dish consisting of seasoned beef & seafood, vegetables & pickled radish rolled in seaweed & rice. It's a flavorful and satisfying roll, perfect for a quick & tasty meal

3032480.name: Fried Crab
3032480.description: Crab is a dish where crabs are typically coated in a seasoned batter and deep-fried until crispy. The seasoning often includes a mix of garlic, ginger, soy sauce, and sometimes gochugaru (Korean red pepper flakes) for a hint of spice.

7610328.name: Spicy Seafood Bulgogi
7610328.description: 1:1 - Seafood bulgogi is a fiery korean dish blending shrimp, squid, octopus, crab with a spicy marinade of gochugaru, garlic & ginger soya sauce

1669742.name: Spicy Beef Bulgogi
1669742.description: 1:1 - Spicy beef bulgogi is a korean dish featuring marinated beef cooked with spicy seasonings, garlic, ginger & soya sauce

2941123.name: BBQ Squid & Octopus
2941123.description: 1:1 - Squid & octopus bbq is a korean dish that features tender pieces of squid & octopus marinated in a flavorful mixture of soy sauce, garlic, sugar & other seasonings

2945650.name: Dak Gang Jjgeong
2945650.description: 7 pcs - Consists of crispy fried chicken pieces coated in a spicy sauce, prepared with a blend of chili paste, soy sauce, garlic & seasonings

2941122.name: Squid BBQ
2941122.description: Squid BBQ is a Korean dish where squid is marinated in a flavorful sauce, typically made with soy sauce, sugar, sesame oil, garlic, and ginger. The marinated squid is then grilled, pan-fried, or stir-fried until tender and infused with the delicious Bulgogi flavors.

2941124.name: Shrimp Tangsu
2941124.description: Shrimp Tangsu is a Korean dish featuring battered and deep-fried shrimp served with a sweet and sour sauce. The shrimp are coated in a light batter, fried until crispy, and then glazed with a tangy sauce made from ingredients like vinegar, sugar, soy sauce, and ketchup.

1669740.name: Stir Fried Mixed Vegetable
1669740.description: Stir-fried mixed vegetables is a dish where a variety of vegetables are quickly cooked in a wok or pan with oil, typically seasoned with soy sauce, garlic, ginger, and sometimes other spices.

2965504.name: Chicken Rajoki
2965504.description: Lightly fried chicken tenders delicately coated in our signature sweet and tangy sauce create a perfect harmony of flavors. This delightful dish pairs exceptionally well with our kimchi fried rice, offering a delicious blend of textures and tastes.

3032481.name: Crab Curry
3032481.description: Korean-style crab curry is a flavorful dish where crab is cooked in a rich and aromatic curry sauce infused with Korean spices. The curry typically features a combination of ingredients such as garlic, ginger, onions, and Korean curry powder, creating a savory and slightly spicy profile.

3032538.name: Chili Crab
3032538.description: Chili crab is a Singaporean and Malaysian seafood dish featuring whole crabs in a rich, savory, and spicy tomato-based sauce. The sauce is made with ingredients like chili, garlic, ginger, and tomato sauce, creating a flavorful and slightly sweet-spicy combination

4748354.name: Tteok - Bokki With Chicken Dumpling
4748354.description: 1:1 - Consists of chewy rice cakes cooked in a spicy, flavorful sauce prepared from gochujung, along with various other ingredients like vegetables

4748368.name: Beef Tangsu
4748368.description: 1:1 - Popular korean dish prepared with thinly sliced beef, coated in sweet and tangy sauce, beef marinated in mixture of soy sauce, sugar, garlic & ketchup

4748369.name: Chicken Tangsu
4748369.description: 1:1 - Popular korean dish prepared with thinly sliced chicken, coated in sweet and tangy sauce, chicken marinated in mixture of soy sauce, sugar, garlic & ketchup

7610329.name: Chicken Teriyaki
7610329.description: 1:1 - Japanese dish consisting of thiny sliced chicken, marinated in a mixture of secrete sauce

7610332.name: Spicy Chicken Bulgogi
7610332.description: 1:1 - Korean dish featuring marinated chicken prepared with spicy seasonings, marinated with gochugaru, garlic, ginger & soy sauce

7610334.name: Beef Teriyaki
7610334.description: 1:1 - Japanese dish consisting of thiny sliced beef thats marinated in a secret teriyaki sauce

3001105.name: Kimchi Fried Rice with Julian Beef
3001105.description: Kimchi fried rice with julienne beef is a flavorful dish that brings together the spicy and tangy notes of kimchi with the rich taste of julienne-cut beef. The dish is prepared by stir-frying cooked rice with kimchi, creating a harmonious blend of flavors. Julienne-cut beef strips are added to the mix, providing protein and a hearty texture.

2941134.name: Kimchi Fried Rice with Juilian Chicken
2941134.description: Kimchi fried rice with julienne chicken is a delicious dish that combines the bold flavors of kimchi and the savory goodness of julienne-cut chicken. The dish is made by stir-frying cooked rice with kimchi, a fermented cabbage dish with spicy and tangy flavors.

2941133.name: Seafood Fried Rice
2941133.description: Seafood fried rice is a delectable dish that features a medley of seafood combined with fried rice. Typically, it includes an assortment of seafood such as shrimp, squid, and sometimes crab or other shellfish. The dish is made by stir-frying cooked rice with the seafood and a mix of vegetables like peas, carrots, and green onions. The flavors are enhanced with soy sauce, garlic, and sometimes ginger.

1669717.name: Mixed Fried Rice
1669717.description: Mixed fried rice is a flavorful dish made by stir-frying a combination of cooked rice with assorted ingredients, such as diced vegetables, meats, and seasonings.

1669719.name: Pineapple Fried Rice
1669719.description: Pineapple fried rice is a flavorful and tropical dish made by stir-frying cooked rice with a combination of ingredients that typically include diced pineapple, vegetables, and protein such as shrimp, chicken.

2941132.name: Mushroom Fried Rice
2941132.description: Mushroom fried rice is a savory dish made by stir-frying cooked rice with a variety of mushrooms and other complementary ingredients. Typically, mushrooms like shiitake, button, or oyster mushrooms are used to impart a rich and earthy flavor to the dish.

1669716.name: Chicken Fried Rice
1669716.description: Chicken fried rice is a popular Asian dish made by stir-frying pre-cooked rice with diced chicken, vegetables, and seasonings. The dish typically includes ingredients like soy sauce, garlic, ginger, and sometimes peas, carrots, and onions.

1669715.name: Sticky Rice
1669715.description: Sticky rice, also known as glutinous rice, is a type of rice with a high starch content that gives it a sticky and chewy texture when cooked. It is commonly used in various Asian cuisines.

1669722.name: Salmon Avocado Salad
1669722.description: Salmon avocado salad is a simple yet flavorful dish consisting of fresh salmon cubes, ripe avocados, crisp lettuce, and sesame seeds. The ingredients are combined to create a harmonious mix of textures and flavors. The salad is often enhanced with a secret sauce, adding a unique and delicious element to the dish.

1669721.name: Pepper Tuna Salad
1669721.description: Pepper tuna salad is a vibrant dish featuring seared or grilled tuna coated with cracked black pepper, served on a bed of fresh greens. The tuna is typically seared briefly to maintain a tender, rare center.

4748343.name: Baechu Kimchi
4748343.description: Baechu kimchi is a traditional Korean dish and one of the most well-known types of kimchi. It is made by fermenting Napa cabbage with a mixture of Korean red pepper flakes (gochugaru), garlic, ginger, scallions, and other seasonings.

6234116.name: Chicken Momo with Garlic Sauce
6234116.description: 6 pcs - Chicken momo with garlic sauce, while distinct from curry, shares similarities in terms of being a flavorful and saucy dish. The momos themselves are dumplings, typically steamed or pan-fried, filled with minced chicken and spices. The garlic sauce, akin to a gravy, provides additional flavor and moisture to the dish.

6234114.name: Chicken Momo
6234114.description: 6 pcs - Chicken momo is a popular and savory dish originating from Tibetan and Nepali cuisines. These are dumplings filled with a mixture of minced or ground chicken, along with various seasonings such as onions, garlic, ginger, and spices.

1669736.name: Beef Dumpling
1669736.description: 6pcs -  Beef dumplings are savory dumplings filled with minced beef, seasonings, and aromatics.

2965646.name: Chicken Dumpling
2965646.description: 6 pcs - hicken dumplings are savory dumplings filled with minced chicken, seasonings, and aromatics.

1669730.name: Prawn Sui Mai
1669730.description: 6 pcs - Chinese dim sum with succulent prawn filling, expertly steamed for a delectable & flavorful experience

2989180.name: Beef Sui Mai
2989180.description: 6 pcs - Chinese dim sum with savory seasoned ground beef filling, steamed to perfection for a juicy & flavorful bite

2989181.name: Chicken Sui Mai
2989181.description: 6 pcs - Chinese dim sum featuring a savory filling of seasoned ground chicken, delicately wrapped & steamed to perfection for a flavorful bite

1669734.name: Prawn Har Gow
1669734.description: 6 pcs - Traditional chinese dim sum with translucent, delicate dumpling skin encasing a succulent prawn filling, showcasing a perfect blend of freshness & flavor

2941117.name: Chicken Har Gow
2941117.description: 6 pcs - Chicken har gow is a Cantonese dumpling filled with minced chicken, bamboo shoots, water chestnuts, and seasonings. Encased in a translucent wheat and tapioca starch wrapper, these dumplings are steamed to perfection, offering a flavorful and juicy chicken filling.

1669747.name: Tuna Nigiri
1669747.description: 6 pcs - Tuna nigiri is a type of sushi composed of a small, hand-pressed mound of vinegared rice topped with a slice of fresh, raw tuna. This classic sushi offering highlights the natural flavors of the tuna and the seasoned rice, often served with a dab of wasabi between the rice and fish.

1669745.name: Salmon Nigiri
1669745.description: 6 pcsc - Salmon nigiri is a type of sushi consisting of a small mound of vinegared rice topped with a fresh, raw slice of salmon. This classic sushi delicacy showcases the natural flavors of the salmon and the seasoned rice, providing a simple yet delightful culinary experience.

1669744.name: Mixed Nigiri
1669744.description: 6pcs - Mixed nigiri features hand-pressed rice topped with fresh, raw tuna, shrimp, and salmon, offering a diverse and flavorful selection in Japanese sushi cuisine.

7966606.name: Beef Kimbap
7966606.description: 6 pcs - A delicious Korean dish consisting of seasoned beef, vegetables & pickled radish rolled in seaweed and rice. It's a flavorful and satisfying roll, perfect for a quick and tasty meal

1669750.name: Tuna Maki
1669750.description: 6 pcs - Tuna maki is a type of sushi roll characterized by a cylindrical shape with a filling of fresh tuna and other ingredients rolled in seaweed (nori) and rice. The roll is typically wrapped in a bamboo mat and sliced into bite-sized pieces.

4748429.name: Tuna Kim Bap
4748429.description: 6pcs - Tuna kimbap, also known as tuna gimbap, is a Korean dish that features seasoned rice, vegetables, and tuna rolled in seaweed sheets (gim or nori). The filling often includes ingredients such as pickled radish, carrots, spinach, and strips of tuna.

7966608.name: Beef Maki
7966608.description: 6 pcs - Beef maki is a type of sushi roll featuring thinly sliced or marinated beef as a key ingredient. The beef is often rolled with other components like vegetables, rice, and sometimes additional condiments or sauce

1669724.name: Salmon Sashimi
1669724.description: 5 slices - Salmon sashimi is a Japanese dish consisting of thinly sliced, fresh raw salmon, presented as a delicacy. The salmon used for sashimi is of high quality, and it is often served in an aesthetically pleasing arrangement.

1669723.name: Tuna Sashimi
1669723.description: 5 slice - Tuna sashimi is a Japanese dish that features thinly sliced, fresh raw tuna served as a delicacy. The tuna is typically high-quality and is presented in an aesthetically pleasing manner.

2941144.name: Dragon Eye Roll
2941144.description: 6pcs - Dragon Eye Roll: Indulge in the mesmerizing flavors of our Dragon Eye Roll. Inside, you'll find a delightful combination of boiled shrimp, tuna, creamy avocado, succulent salmon, and crab stick, creating a symphony of textures. Topped with a drizzle of spicy mayo sauce, a sprinkle of ebiko (fish roe), and a touch of sesame seeds, this roll is a true feast for the senses.

2941145.name: Maguro Katsu Maki
2941145.description: 6 pcs - Maguro Katsu Maki Deluxe: Indulge in the ultimate tuna experience with our Maguro Katsu Maki Deluxe. Generously filled with tuna katsu, a sumptuous blend of deep-fried and succulent tuna, both inside and on top, this roll promises an abundance of rich and satisfying flavors. Complemented by creamy avocado, crisp cucumber, and perfectly seasoned rice, each bite is a harmonious blend of textures.

2941146.name: Salmon Katsu Maki
2941146.description: 6 pcs - Salmon Katsu Maki Deluxe: Elevate your sushi experience with our Salmon Katsu Maki Deluxe. Featuring lavish amounts of salmon katsu salmon that's expertly breaded and deep-fried both inside and on top, this roll promises an abundance of rich and satisfying flavors. Complemented by creamy avocado, crisp cucumber, and perfectly seasoned rice, each bite is a harmonious blend of textures.

1669754.name: Volcano Roll
1669754.description: 6pcs - Volcano Roll: Indulge in the explosive flavors of our Volcano Roll, featuring succulent fried prawn, creamy avocado, and luscious cheese. Torched to perfection and generously drizzled with spicy mayonnaise sauce, this roll delivers a fiery kick. Topped with a crunchy eruption, our Volcano Roll is a symphony of textures and tastes that will ignite your taste buds.

2941143.name: Dragon of Fire Roll
2941143.description: 6pcs - Dragon of Fire Sushi Roll: Ignite your taste buds with our Dragon of Fire Sushi Roll. Inside, revel in the harmony of creamy avocado, succulent crab stick, and crisp carrot, all enhanced with our signature sauce. Topped with a layer of torched crab stick and cucumber, this roll delivers a fiery sensation that will leave you enchanted.

1669757.name: Tiger Roll
1669757.description: 6pcs - Tiger Roll: Unleash the bold flavors of our Tiger Roll, featuring a delectable combination of creamy cheese, ripe avocado, crispy fried prawn, and refreshing cucumber. Topped with a luscious drizzle of honey mustard sauce and a sprinkle of ebiko (fish roe), this roll embodies the perfect balance of textures and tastes.

2941147.name: Naruto Maki Roll
2941147.description: 6 pcs - Tuna & Avocado Naruto Maki: Immerse yourself in the exquisite flavors of our Tuna & Avocado Naruto Maki. This carb-free delight is a lavish ensemble of abundant tuna and creamy avocado nestled within thinly sliced cucumber, offering a refreshing and light alternative to traditional sushi. Each bite is a harmonious blend of the buttery richness of avocado and the succulent taste of premium tuna, creating a memorable sushi experience.

1669758.name: Rainbow California Roll
1669758.description: 6pcs - Rainbow California Roll: Experience a burst of colors and flavors with our Rainbow California Roll. This classic roll is crafted with a center of crab or imitation crab, cucumber, and avocado, wrapped in seaweed and rice. What sets it apart is the vibrant array of fresh sashimi-style fish, including tuna, salmon,  and avocado, artfully arranged on top.

1669755.name: Summer Roll
1669755.description: 6 pcs - Summer Roll: Dive into the vibrant flavors of our Summer Roll, a delightful combination of fried prawn, creamy cheese, avocado, and refreshing cucumber. Topped with luscious tuna and torched to perfection, it's crowned with a tantalizing spicy mayonnaise sauce. This roll is a harmonious blend of textures and tastes, bringing the essence of summer to your palate.

2941152.name: Spicy Tuna Roll
2941152.description: 6pcs - Spicy Tuna Roll: A sushi classic with a spicy twist. Inside, enjoy a tantalizing blend of fresh tuna mixed with a fiery spicy mayo sauce, delivering a perfect harmony of heat and savory goodness. Encased in seaweed and rice, this roll offers a delightful kick for those who appreciate a bit of spice in their sushi. The Spicy Tuna Roll is a flavorful and popular choice, capturing the essence of bold and satisfying sushi enjoyment.

2941150.name: Spicy Salmon Roll
2941150.description: 6 pcs - Spicy Salmon Roll: A zesty and flavorful sushi roll that packs a punch. Inside, you'll find fresh and succulent salmon mixed with a spicy mayo sauce for a kick of heat. This delectable filling is wrapped in seaweed and rice, creating a perfect balance of spicy and savory flavors. The Spicy Salmon Roll is a popular choice for those who crave a bit of heat along with the richness of high-quality salmon in their sushi experience.

1669753.name: Love Maki Roll
1669753.description: 6pcs - Love Maki Roll: Indulge in the romantic charm of our Love Maki Roll, shaped with affection and crafted with a delightful combination of cheese, sumptuous salmon, and creamy avocado inside. This special creation is not only a treat for the taste buds but also a visual delight. To enhance the love-filled experience, the roll is elegantly topped with glistening salmon roe, adding a burst of color and flavor. Share the love with this uniquely shaped and delectable sushi roll.

2941151.name: Philedelphia Salmon Roll
2941151.description: 6 pcs - Philadelphia Salmon Roll: A luscious and savory sushi roll that captures the essence of Philadelphia flavors. This delectable roll typically features fresh salmon, smooth cream cheese, cucumber, and sometimes avocado, all rolled in seaweed and rice. The result is a delightful combination of rich, creamy textures and the natural taste of high-quality salmon. Enjoy the sophisticated and satisfying taste of our Philadelphia Salmon Roll.

1669749.name: Crispy Prawn Tempura Roll
1669749.description: 6 pcs - Crispy prawn tempura roll: A delectable combination of fried prawn, creamy avocado, and crispy fried egg wrapped in a roll, enhanced with cheese and a coating of golden breadcrumbs. Served with a delightful honey mustard sauce for a perfect blend of flavors and textures. Enjoy the unique and delicious experience of our crispy prawn tempura roll।

1669752.name: Green Dragon Roll
1669752.description: 6 pcs - A sushi delight featuring eel, avocado, and cucumber rolled in seaweed and rice. Topped with thin avocado slices to resemble dragon scales and drizzled with sweet sauce for a savory touch. The Green Dragon Roll offers a visually stunning presentation and a delicious combination of flavors in every bite

2941153.name: Beef Bulgogi Roll
2941153.description: 6 pcs - A Korean dish featuring thinly sliced and marinated beef bulgogi rolled with vegetables, creating a flavorful & savory delight

2941156.name: Salmon Logs Crispy Roll
2941156.description: 6 pcs - A fusion delight featuring avocado, salmon, and cheese inside, wrapped, fried to crispiness, and topped with honey mustard. The combination offers a unique blend of textures and flavors, from the richness of salmon and cheese to the creaminess of avocado, all enhanced by the sweet & tangy notes of honey mustard

2949168.name: Torched Crab Roll
2949168.description: 6 pcs -  Flavorful sushi creation filled with crab stick, avocado, cucumber wrapped in sushi rice - Topped with a layer of crab meat mixed with mayonnaise

2941159.name: California Roll
2941159.description: 6 pcs-  California Roll: A classic sushi roll that has stood the test of time, the California Roll features a filling of imitation crab or real crab, cucumber, and avocado, rolled in seaweed and rice. The roll is often served with pickled ginger, wasabi, and soy sauce for dipping.

2941149.name: Sweet Tiger Roll
2941149.description: 6 pcs - A decadent delight featuring a filling of creamy cheese, crispy fried prawn, and avocado. Topped with a luscious drizzle of sweet soy sauce and a satisfying crunch, this roll skips the nori for a unique twist on texture & flavor

1669726.name: Korean Style Seafood Soup
1669726.description: 1:1  - Korean Style Seafood Soup: Dive into the depths of Korean culinary delight with our seafood soup. Brimming with an assortment of fresh seafood like shrimp, clams, mussels, and squid, it features a rich broth infused with Korean spices, garlic, ginger, and gochugaru for a perfect balance of savory and slightly spicy flavors. Garnished with green onions and herbs, this Korean Style Seafood Soup promises a satisfying and comforting dining experience.

1669727.name: Miso Soup
1669727.description: 1:1  - Miso Soup: A classic Japanese dish that embodies simplicity and umami. Our Miso Soup features a delicate broth made with miso paste, which is fermented soybean paste. This comforting soup is often complemented with tofu cubes, seaweed (such as wakame), and sliced green onions. The result is a harmonious blend of savory and slightly salty flavors. Served hot and garnished with green onions.

1669728.name: Dak - Gae Jang
1669728.description: 1:1  -  Dak Gae Jang: A bold and hearty Korean dish, Dak Gae Jang is a spicy chicken stew that delights the palate with robust flavors. Tender pieces of chicken are simmered in a rich, spicy broth infused with garlic, ginger, and Korean chili paste. The stew is further enriched with soy sauce and sesame oil, creating a complex and savory profile. Garnished with green onions and sesame seeds, Dak Gae Jang is a comforting and satisfying dish that exemplifies the bold and spicy essence of Korean cuisine.

2965619.name: Thai Soup
2965619.description: 1:1  - Thai Soup (No Tofu, No High-Fen): Immerse yourself in the vibrant and aromatic flavors of our authentic Thai soup, crafted without tofu and free from high-fen ingredients. This savory and fragrant soup features a rich broth made with coconut milk, lemongrass, galangal, and Thai herbs. Choose your preferred protein, such as chicken or shrimp, and relish in the harmonious balance of sweetness, spiciness, and tanginess.

4748307.name: Kimchi Jjigae with Chicken
4748307.description: 1:1 - Kimchi Jjigae with Chicken: Experience the heartiness of Korean comfort food with our Kimchi Jjigae featuring tender chicken. The combination of spicy, savory, and tangy notes creates a soul-warming dish that embodies the essence of Korean cuisine.

2985007.name: Kimchi Jjigae With Beef

1669711.name: Soya Ramen
1669711.description: 1:1 - Soyo Ramen: Dive into the delectable world of Soyo Ramen, a savory delight featuring tender beef, a perfectly boiled egg, satay vegetables, and flavorful noodles in a rich soup. 1669713.name: Miso Ramen
1669713.description: 1:1 -  Chicken Miso Ramen: Revel in the comforting flavors of our Chicken Miso Ramen, where the richness of miso-flavored broth meets tender chicken. Garnished with sliced chicken, green onions, seaweed, and optional additions like corn or bean sprouts, it offers a delightful balance of umami and hearty textures. 7513848.name: Roasted Chicken Ramen
